samples.hyp: Ukuhlola izinga elidingekayo lokuhlolwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2 ngokujwayelekile ukuze kungenzeka ukulawula ukuqhamuka kwesifo esifundeni esiyisizinda iLusaka eZambia ngokucatshangelwa kwabantu okungenazimpawu:
Ucwaningo olulula lwemodeli yezibalo

Isifo esisha sokhuvethe (COVID-19), esidalwa igciwane elicindezela ukuphefumula—2 (SARS-CoV-2), e-Afrika sibonakala ngokuba nenani elikhulu labantu okungenazimpawu (noma abanezimpawu ezincane) abacatshangwa ukuthi badlala indima ekusakazekeni kwalesi sifo.
Isilinganiso esiqondile kanye nezinga lokuthelelanayo kwabantu okungenazimpawu kusalokhu kungacaci.
Nokho izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwazo kubalulekile ekulawuleni ukudlulisa kwe-SARS-CoV-2.

Sakha imodeli yezibalo elula okokunquma yo-sengozini-evezwe-ethelelanayo-esusiwe (SEIR) ukuze sihlaziye umphumela wokuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwabantu abathelelwe yi-SARS-CoV-2 kodwa okungenazimpawu ngokuhlolwa okubanzi ukuze kulawulwe ukuqhamuka eSifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia.

Lapha senze imodeli yezimo ezimbili; (1) sicabanga ukuthi abantu abangenaso isifo esibonakalayo babumba u-70% wawo wonke amacala e-COVID-19 futhi (2) abantu abangenaso isifo esibonakalayo babumba u-50% kuphela wamacala.

Ukuze kuqhathaniswe, imodeli yahlolwa kuqala ngaphansi komcabango wokuthi abantu abangenaso isifo bayafana ngokutheleleka nabantu abanezimpawu bese kuthi okwesibili, futhi okungenzeka kakhulu, kucatshangwa ukuthi abantu abangenaso isifo bangaba yingxenye kuphela yokutheleleka kwabantu abanezimpawu.

Kumodeli ecabanga amacala angama-70% okungenazimpawu, izinga elincane lokuhlolwa kwansuku zonke eliqhubekayo elingu-≥ 7911 test answer/100000 abantu bendawo belanele ukulawula ukuqubuka uma abantu abangenaso isifo bengaba yisigamu kuphela sokuthelelana kuyilapho uma kucatshangwa ukuthelelana okulinganayo khona-ke izinga lokuhlolwa elingu-≥ 10028 test answer/100000 abantu bendawo belizodingeka.

Ngokwe-50% okungenazimpawu, izinga elincane lokuhlolwa okukhulu elingaphezu kuka-4540 test answer/ 100000 abantu bendawo lalanele ukulawula ukuqubuka ezingeni elibekwe lokuthelelana kwabantu okungenazimpawu uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abanezimpawu.
Ingxoxo nesiphetho

Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi ukuzihlukanisa okusebenzayo kwamacala e-COVID-19, okuhlanganisa nabantu okungenazimpawu, ngokusebenzisa ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasetshenziswa njengesinyathelo esingaba khona sokulawula ukudluliswa kwe-SARS-Cov-2 eLusaka, eZambia, kodwa kuzoba nezindleko eziphezulu.
Ukuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi emadolobheni amakhulu njengeLusaka kungase kunciphise ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19, kodwa kuyasebenza yini?

Ngowe-2020, amamodeli ekhompyutha abikezela ukuthi ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu kungalawulwa kangcono ngokuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi, bese kuthi bonke abathole imiphumela emihle bahlukaniswe.
Nokho, abacwaningi bathi le ndlela ingase ibize futhi ingabi yenzekayo.
Ekuqaleni kwempathamhlaba, abantu abaningi ababetholakale bene-COVID-19 babengabonisi zimpawu zesifo kodwa basabalalisa isifo kwabanye.
Ezinye izifundo ziphakamise ukuthi ama-50% kuya ku-80% wabantu abane-COVID-19 ababenazimpawu (okungenazimpawu) futhi kungenzeka ukuthi babenesibopho sama-40% kuya ku-70% sezifo ezintsha.
Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuthola nokuhlukanisa abantu okungenazimpawu kungasiza yini ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.
Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwe-banket, okusho ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, kuyakwazi yini ukuthola abantu okungenazimpawu ngempumelelo.
Abacwaningi basungule imodeli yekhompyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu badlula kanjani ekubeni sengozini kuya ekuvezweni obala, ekuthelelekeni, nasekuhlukanisweni.
Bagxile kudatha evela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyisikhungo sezinkampani esinendawo yezindiza yamazwe ngamazwe elinganiselana namazwe amabili.

Ngenxa yokuthi izici ze-COVID-19 zazibonakala zihlukahluka ukusuka endaweni kuya kwenye, babheka izimo ezine, lapho amacala e-COVID-19 angaba yi-50% noma i-70% ayengazimpawu, futhi la macala ayengaba ethelelanayo ngokulinganayo noma ingxenye njengalawo anezimpawu.

Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi kungenzeka ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza ama-test answer jikelele nangokuhlukanisa bonke abantu abathole ukuthi banegciwane, ngisho nalabo abangenaso izimpawu.
Bathi ukuze kwehliswe inani eliphezulu lezigameko ngama-90% kuzo zonke izimo, abantu abangu-10% eLusaka kwakudingeka bahlolwe nsuku zonke.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina inani lezifo ezintsha ze-COVID-19 lihlala lingashintshi, u-22% wabantu kumele bahlolwe nsuku zonke.
Yize iZambia ibeke izinyathelo eziningi zokunciphisa i-COVID-19, izigameko zisabonakala zikhuphuka.
Ukuhlolwa okubanzi kwehlise ngempumelelo isibalo samacala e-COVID-19 ngama-90% edolobheni elincane e-Italy.
Kodwa, azikho izifundo zangaphambili eziphakamisa ukuthi kuzosebenza edolobheni elikhulu kwenye indawo.

Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abenzanga ngempela ukuhlolwa okubanzi kulesi sifundo; kunalokho benza imodeli ephakamisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasebenza ukunciphisa ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu.
Nokho, baxwayise ukuthi kungenzeka kube kubiza kakhulu.
Baphinde bathi kungase kube lula uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinyathelo, ezifana nokuvalwa kwezwe thaqa, ukulandelela abathintwayo, kanye nokugoma.
Abacwaningi baseZambia baphinde bagcizelela ukuthi izigameko ze-COVID-19 okungenazimpawu zazibonakala zivamile e-Afrika ngaleso sikhathi.
Ukutholakala okuvamile okuphansi kwemiphumela ye-polygenic kubantu bendawo base-Afrika ngenxa yokwehlukahlukana kofuzo kanye nemvelo.
Abantu base-Afrika abameleki kahle ezincwaningweni zofuzo kodwa banokwehlukahlukana okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo futhi babhekene nokuchayeka kwemvelo okubanzi emhlabeni wonke.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukuhlolwa okuhlelekile kokubikezela kofuzo kwakungakenzeki ezizukulwaneni ezihlanganisa ukuhlukahlukana kwe-Afrika, sabala amaphuzu obungozi be-polygenic (PRS) kuzimo ezihlukahlukene e-Afrika nase-ulwazi olusebenzayo oluvela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuze siqonde kangcono ukujwayeleka kocwaningo lwezofuzo.
Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuthuthuka kakhulu ngamathimba okuthola afaniswa ngokhokho kunokutholakala ezincwaningweni ezingahambisani ngokhokho.
Phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlukahlukene ngokwezizukulwane nobuzwe, sithola ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izimpawu kodwa kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwamaqembu.
Umehluko ezizukulwaneni zase-Afrika unomthelela omkhulu ekwehlukaneni kokunemba kwe-PRS kunokwehluka okukhulu kwezinye izigaba ezicatshangelwe phakathi kwabantu base-UK uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Uganda.

Sisebenzise izilinganiso ze-PRS kubantu bendawo abanezizinda zase-Afrika sisebenzisa izifundo zofuzo ezikhona ezivela e-Europe kuphela uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo zofuzo ezihlukahlukene; ukwanda kokuhlukahluka kwaveza inzuzo enkulu kunazo zonke yokunemba ekugxileni kwe-ihemogilobhini nasekubalweni kwamangqamuzana egazi amhlophe, okukhombisa ukuhlukahluka okukhulu okuthuthukisiwe kofuzo olwaziwayo oluthinta i-anemia yeseli eliyisigaxa kanye nokuphendula okutholakala, ngokulandelana.
Umehluko ekunembeni kwe-PRS phakathi kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika ezisuka ezifundeni ezihlukahlukene mkhulu njengokuhlukana kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika, okudinga ukuqonda okufanele.
Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela kahle izifo zofuzo kubantu abanezimpande zase-Afrika
Abacwaningi bathi izindlela ezisetshenziswa okwamanje ukubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzothuthukisa isifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isizindalwazi esingemuva kwalokhu kubikezela ikakhulukazi sichaza ufuzo lwabantu abavela e-Europe.
I-database ye-GWAS imele "Izifundo Zokuhlangana Kwe-Genome-Wide", futhi ososayensi bayisebenzisa ukubheka izici nezifo ezisuselwe kofuzo.
Eqinisweni, bangasebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ubungozi bofuzo bomuntu ngesifo noma isici.
Iningi lolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ku-GWAS, nokho, luvela kubantu bezizukulwane zase-Europe.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukubona ukuthi isibalo abasisebenzisayo ukunquma ubungozi bezifo zofuzo kusetshenziswa i-GWAS sisebenza kahle kangakanani kubantu abanezimpande zase-Afrika.
Baphinde bafuna ukubona ukuthi uma i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi isizindalwazi esifaka ulwazi lwezofuzo lwase-Afrika oluningi, kungathuthukisa izibikezelo.
Ukubalwa kwaziwa ngamagama esayensi kakhulu ngokuthi “umphumela wengozi ye-polygenic”, noma i-PRS.

Basebenzisa amakhompyutha ukubala ubungozi bofuzo obubikezelwe babantu base-Afrika besebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzisa amarekhodi ezokwelapha abantu base-Afrika ukubheka izimpawu ezithile noma izifo ezingase zibe zibangelwe izinguquko zofuzo.

Lapho besebenzisa i-GWAS yase-Europe, bathola ukuthi umphumela wengozi yofuzo wawunembe kakhudlwana uma abantu babenezizukulwane zase-Europe uma kuqhathaniswa nezizukulwane zase-Afrika ezimweni eziningi.
Bathi amaphuzu obungozi aphansi kakhulu phakathi kwezifunda zase-Afrika ngoba kunokwehlukahlukana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu bendawo, okungahambisani nalokho esikubonayo ngozalo lwase-Europe.
Baphinde bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyakhula njengoba umsuka wase-Afrika wehla.
Abantu base-Ethiopia babe nezibikezelo ezingcono zezifo zofuzo njengoba befana kakhulu ngokofuzo nabantu base-Europe.
Lapho kusetshenziswa i-GWAS ehlukahlukene ehlanganisa abantu abavela e-Afrika, ukunemba kokubikezela kuthuthukisiwe.
Ukubikezela izifo zegazi bekunembile kakhulu.
Izifundo zangaphambilini zibonise ukuthi i-PRS iphansi kubantu base-Afrika, okusho ukuthi i-database ye-GWAS ibikezela ingozi ephansi yezifo zofuzo kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Kodwa siyazi ukuthi lokhu akulona iqiniso ngempela.

Lolu cwaningo luchaza ukuthi le miphumela ephansi yobungozi bezifo zofuzo kungenxa yokuthi ufuzo lwase-Afrika alumeleki kahle kudathabheyisi ye-GWAS, ngakho-ke amanani e-PRS okwamanje awasizi ngempela ukubikezela izifo zofuzo e-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi kungaba ngcono ukusebenzisa isizindalwazi esihlukahlukene esifaka ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo oluvela kubantu bozalo lwase-Afrika.
Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi owengeziwe uyadingeka ukuze kuhlukaniswe i-GWAS ukuze kufakwe inzalo yase-Afrika ukuze sikwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile ubungozi bezifo zofuzo kubantu bendawo base-Afrika.
Ababhali balolu cwaningo bebevela e-Afrika, e-USA nase-UK.
Ukuhlolwa Kokubona Nokuhlolwa Kwezifo Zamaseli Ekugwemeni I-Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia Nomdlavuza Womlomo Wesibeletho eNamibia
Kulinganiselwa ukuthi abesifazane abangu-851 340 eNamibia basengozini yokutheleleka ngegciwane le-human papilloma (HPV) elingabangela umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.
Ukuhlolwa ngeso lokhozi nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kufakazelwe ukuthi kuyasebenza kakhulu.
Nokho, ulwazi oluhlobene nomthelela wezinhlelo zokuhlola umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho luyashoda.
Lolu cwaningo luhlolile ukuhlolwa ngeso nange-cytology ekuvimbeleni izilonda zangaphakathi zesibeletho (CIN) nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho eNamibia.
Okutholakele kubonise ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis kanye ne-atypia basengozini enkulu yokuthola imiphumela emihle ye-VIA.
Abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi abane-HIV, banamathuba amaningi okutholakala ne-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Inqubo ye-VIA ibonakala iyasebenza ekuhloleni, nakuba i-colposcopy ekulandeleni isiguli kumongo waseNamibia kufanele ibuyekezwe futhi isetshenziswe nemiphumela emihle ye-HR-HPV.
Izindlela zokuhlolwa ezihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kubantu beminyaka ehlukene kanye nabantu abasezingeni eliphezulu (isb. i-HIV, izifo zamasosha omzimba) kuyacebiswa.

Ukukhetha ukuhlolwa kungathuthukiswa ngokwengeziwe ngokungenelela okwamukela imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yokuxilonga yangaphambilini, izinhloso zezempilo zabesifazane, ulwazi olusesikhathini kanye nomkhuba ohambisana nesimo sezwe.
Abesifazane baseNamibia abasengozini yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi baphathwe kusenesikhathi.
Kukhona ama-test amaningi angakhombisa ubungozi besifazane ngomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, kodwa ukuhlolwa okuvamile eNamibia akuhlali kusebenzisa lezi test.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuthola izimpawu zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi, kungavimbela abasifazane ekuthuthukiseni lesi sifo esibulalayo.
Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho (umdlavuza wesigaba esiphansi sesibeletho) ubangela ukufa okuningi kwabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele.
Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
I-HPV yigciwane elilimaza amaseli esibeletho, likha izilonda ezibizwa ngokuthi izilonda, ezingagcina ziba nomdlavuza.
Noma umgomo wokuvimbela i-HPV ukhona, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganisa neNamibia, abakwazi ukuwuthola.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola igciwane noma izilonda ezidalwa yilo kubaluleke kakhulu kwabesifazane laba, njengoba kuyindlela engcono yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi izibhedlela ngakho-ke zidinga iziqondiso ezifanele nolwazi mayelana nezivivinyo ezinhle kakhulu okufanele zisetshenziswe.
Banezela ukuthi nabasebenzi bezokwelapha badinga ulwazi oluthe xaxa mayelana nokuthi izici ezifana nobudala noma impilo zithinta kanjani ingozi yowesifazane yokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Baphenyile ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezivamile zokuhlolwa (ezibizwa ngokuthi izindlela zokuhlola) ezazisebenza kahle ekutholeni i-HPV nezilonda.
Bebefuna futhi ukuqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlolwa, isibonelo ukuqoqa amaseli esibelethweni ukuze kuhlolwe umonakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhlola izilonda kuphela.
Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhluka phakathi kwabesifazane, njengeminyaka yabo, noma ukuthi ngabe banezinye izifo ezifana ne-HIV, kushintsha amathuba abo okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Ukwazi lolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nezikhungo zezempilo ukuthi zisebenzise izindlela zokuhlolwa ngendlela ephumelelayo.
Abacwaningi babheke amarekhodi eziguli zabesifazane abangu-214 ababehlolwe futhi baphathwa nge-HPV, izilonda, nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho esibhedlela eWindhoek, eNamibia.
Bagxile ikakhulukazi kumdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho osesigabeni sokuqala, okuyisikhathi lapho isifo singalapheka kalula futhi ngempumelelo.
Baqoqa nolwazi ngeminyaka yowesifazane ngamunye, kanye nempilo yakhe evamile.

Ngokubuyekeza lezi zirekhodi, bathola ukuthi izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlolwa zivame ukunikeza izisebenzi zezokwelapha ulwazi oluhlukile, futhi kungenzeka zibe usizo olukhulu ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuba i-HPV isiphenduke umdlavuza.
Umdlavuza, isibonelo, wawuvame ukutholakala ngokuqoqa nokuhlola amaseli esibeletho.
Izilonda, nokho, zingatholakala kaningi ngokuhlolwa ngeso, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlolwa ngeso nge-acetic acid" (VIA).
Inzuzo yaleli qhinga ukuthi livumela odokotela ukuthola izilonda ngokushesha nangokushibhile.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isebenzisa imishini yezokwelapha eyisisekelo esivele isetshenziswa ekuhlolweni kwezifo zabesifazane, njengokuthi isebenzise ispeculum (ithuluzi lensimbi elisetshenziselwa ukubheka ngaphakathi kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane).
Baphinde bathola ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukunikeza odokotela ulwazi oluningi mayelana nengozi yomfazi yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuhlolwa okuningi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abane-HIV, babenamathuba amaningi okutholakala benomdlavuza, ngakho-ke ukuhlolwa kwabo njalo kungaba kubaluleke kakhulu.
Abacwaningi bangezelela ukuthi abesifazane abambalwa kakhulu bahlolelwe i-HPV (ngaphambi kokufuna izilonda) nakuba kunokuhlolwa okukhona.
Ukukwenza lokho kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola lesi sifo ngokushesha kakhulu.

Sekukonke, bathi imiphumela yabo ibonise ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi uhlelo lwezempilo eNamibia luhlele izindlela zokuvimbela i-HPV nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ngokucophelela, kusetshenziswa izindlela zokuhlola ezishibhile nezisebenzayo ukuthola lezi zifo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Lolu cwaningo beluwukusebenzisana kososayensi baseNamibia nabaseNingizimu Afrika.
Inzuzo yokwelashwa ekuthelelekeni kwe-HBV/i-HIV uma kuqhathaniswa nokutheleleka kwe-HBV kuphela eqoqweni laseNingizimu Afrika

Sikhuthazwe okuqondiwe kwamazwe omhlaba kokususa igciwane le-impathas’bindi (HBV), siqale ukuhlukanisa abantu abane-HBV monoinfection uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HBV/i-HIV, ukuhlola umthelela wokwelashwa nokuhola ukuthuthukiswa ekunakekelweni kwezokwelapha.
Sibika ulwazi lokubuka oluqhamuka eqoqweni elibanzi labantu abadala abayi-115 abane-impathas’bindi amahlalakhona (CHB), esibhedlela saseyunivesithi eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukutheleleka kanyekanye ne-HIV bekukhona kubantu abangu-39 (34%).
Saqopha ulwazi lwezakhiwo zabantu, lwezokwelapha nolwelebhu lwezigaba ezihlukene.

Uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, abantu abadala abane-HBV monoinfection babengatholakali kalula ukuthi banayo i-HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), babengatholakali kalula ukuthi bahlolwe nge-elastography (p<0.0001), futhi babengatholakali kalula ukuthi bathola ukwelashwa nge-antiviral (p<0.0001); babengatholakali kalula ukuthi banayo i-HBV viraemia (p=0.04), futhi babengatholakali kalula ukuthi banezimpawu zesifo sesibindi ezihlanganisa i-thrombocytopaenia ephakathi nendawo/enamandla (p=0.007), i-bilirubin ephakeme (p=0.004), kanye nomphumela we-APRI ophakeme (p=0.02).
Amacala amathathu e-hephathoselula sasinoma avela ku-HBV monoinfection.

Ulwazi lwethu lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV monoinfection bangase babe nenkathazo uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, kugcizelela ukungalingani okungenzeka ohlelweni lokudluliselwa, ukuqapha kanye nokwelashwa.
Abacwaningi banikeza imihlahlandlela yokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa kwe-impathas’bindi/nkukhumalisa s’bindi/ i-hepatatis b.

Ocwaningweni lwakamuva, abacwaningi bakwazile ukuveza ukuthi ukutheleleka kokubili impathas’bindi (HBV) kanye ne-human immunodeficiency virus (i-HIV) kunganikeza inzuzo yokwelashwa phezu kokutheleleka nge-HBV kuphela.
ENingizimu Afrika, ukutheleleka ngama-HBV kanye ne-HIV amahlalakhona kuyinkinga enkulu.
Odokotela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo namakhambi asetshenziselwa ukuwelapha azihlangana kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlonza kangcono nokunakekela iziguli.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokwelashwa ezigulini ezine-HBV kuphela, nezine-HBV kanye ne-HIV.
Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi babutha iziguli ezingu-115 ezikhulile ezinegciwane lempathas’bindi elingamahlalakhona (CHB).
Baqashwe esibhedlela saseTygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ezinye iziguli zazitheleleke nge-HIV (39) kanti ezinye zazitheleleke nge-HBV kuphela.
Abacwaningi babheka uhlanga, iminyaka nobulili, futhi benza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene zokwelapha nezaselebhu.

Bathola ukuthi iziguli ezine-HBV kuphela kungenzeka zingayitholi imishanguzo yokulwa namagciwane, zibonisa izimpawu zemvelo zesifo sesibindi (ngoba i-HBV yigciwane elingadala isifo sesibindi esinzima).

Abacwaningi bakwazile ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela babenenzuzo encane uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ne-HBV, njengoba iziguli eziphethwe yilezi zinhlobo ezimbili zamagciwane kungenzeka ukuthi zisebenzisa imishanguzo ye-HIV, enikeza inzuzo ethile ekulweni nokutheleleka kwe-HBV.

Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo igqamisa umthelela ongaba khona wokwehluka phakathi kokudluliselwa, ukuqapha nezinketho zokwelashwa kwe-HBV uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhlangana kwe-HIV ne-HBV, okuvuna labo abangenwe yi-HIV ne-HBV.
Abacwaningi bagcizelele ukuthi kumele sithuthukise futhi sinikeze insizakalo ephephile nefanele kubaguli abangenwe yi-HBV kuphela.
Omunye umkhawulo wocwaningo lolu usayizi omncane wabantu bendawo obekhethekile ezweni elilodwa kuphela kanye nezinhlelo zabo zezibhedlela.
Ezinye izibhedlela, mhlawumbe ezithuthukile kakhulu, zingase zibonise umbono ohlukile uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okutholakele kulesi sifundo.
Kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe izifundo ezengeziwe ukuze kutholakale umehluko otholakele kulolu cwaningo.
Leli phepha libonise amandla okubambisana, lapho abacwaningi besebenza kulo msebenzi bevela eNingizimu Afrika naseMbusweni WamaNgisi.
Ngokusebenzisa abantu bendawo baseNingizimu Afrika kulolu cwaningo, kubalulekile engxenyeni yabantu bendawo base-Afrika.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwelapha ezingcono kulabo abahlushwa yi-HBV, i-HIV noma kokubili.
Ukuhlolwa Kwethonya Lokungaphephi Emisebenzini Yezamabhizinisi Yabesifazane Endaweni Yomkhandlu Wasekhaya e-SHIRORO eSifundazweni saseNiger

Lolu cwaningo luhlolisise umthelela wokungabi nokuvikeleka emisebenzini yobungcweti yabesifazane eShiroro Local Government Area eSifundazweni saseNiger, kugxilwe ikakhulukazi ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuncika kwezimali kwabesifazane, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yobungcweti evamile phakathi kwabo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungabi nokuvikeleka emizamweni yabo yobungcweti.

Isampula yabesifazane abangu-377 yahlolisiswa, okuholele ekutholeni ukuthi abesifazane baseShiroro banamakhono amakhulu okuzimela kwezamabhizinisi, futhi bazimela kakhulu kwezezimali, bebandakanya kakhulu kuma-SME.

Ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi yize ukuvikeleka okungesihle kunomthelela ongemuhle emisebenzini yebhizinisi yabesifazane ngendlela yokulahlekelwa noma ukwehla kwezimali phakathi kwezinye izinto, inani labesifazane abaqalayo amabhizinisi alizange libonise ukwehla okukhulu.

Ucwaningo luncoma ukuthi kudalwe izinhlelo ezisimeme zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zezezimali ngabesifazane, futhi kudalwe futhi kuqiniswe izinhlangano zomphakathi zokuphepha ukuze kulwiswe ukuvikeleka endaweni yocwaningo.
Abesifazane abahwebayo eNiger badinga ukuvikeleka okwengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abahweba eNiger banamakhono amakhulu okuzimela kwezomnotho futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezinsolweni zobugebengu kuyinkinga.

Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi abesifazane abaphethe amabhizinisi eShiroro Local Government Area eNiger State baphephile futhi bavikelekile kangakanani, nokuthi lokhu kungaba namuphi umthelela emabhizinisini abo nasekuzimeleni kwezezimali.
Baxoxisana nabesifazane abangu-377 kule ndawo mayelana nezinselelo ababhekana nazo maqondana nemisebenzi yabo yokuzisebenzela, ukuncika kwezezimali kanye nokungaqiniseki.
Babike ukuthi u-43% wabesifazane bathe abancikile emadodeni ngemali, kanti u-32% bathe banabanye abantu abancike kubo ngemali.
Abacwaningi bathole nokuthi ama-85% abesifazane benza imali emabhizinisini ahlukahlukene, kanti bambalwa kuphela abathi bathembele emiholweni.
Cishe ama-56% benza imali ngokulima, kanti ama-79% benza imali ngokuhweba.
Cishe oyedwa kwabahlanu besifazane bathola imali ngokuluka izinwele, ukuthunga, ukufekethisa noma ukuwasha izingubo.
Iningi labesifazane (91%) litshele abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athintekile ngenxa yokwesaba kwabo ukuhlaselwa amasela nezigelekeqe.
Balahlekelwa yimali ngisho nabayeni babo kulezi zihlaselo, kwesinye isikhathi kuphoqa ukuthi banakekele izingane zabo bodwa.
Abesifazane baphinde bathi ababenazo izikhono ezanele nemali yokwandisa amabhizinisi abo.
Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwezozinkinga, abasifazane baseNiger baqhubeka benza kahle kakhulu emabhizinisini abo.
Bathe eShiroro kunabantu bezinhlanga nezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi lokhu bekulungele ibhizinisi.
Lolu cwaningo luphenya imiphumela yabanye abacwaningi abathi abesifazane baphumelela kancane ebhizinisini ngenxa yokuba abanakekeli ekhaya.
Esikhundleni salokho, laba bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane abahweba kule ndawo yaseNiger ithinteka kakhulu usongo lokuhlaselwa yizigebengu namasela.
Abacwaningi batusa ukuthi bonke ababambe iqhaza kufanele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingaba yinkinga ekuphumeleleni ebhizinisini.
Isibonelo, abesifazane eNiger kufanele bathole ukufinyelela okwengeziwe kwezimali, amapulazi nokuphepha.
Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi abesifazane abasezamabhizinisi bangakha amaqembu azobasiza ukulwa nezigelekeqe kanye nezaphulamthetho.

Ukugxila kwe-Serum komama kweSelenium, Umthofi kanye neZinki ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kuhlotshaniswa nobungozi bokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi okungazelelwe: Ucwaningo lwecala nokulawula oluvela eMalawi
Ukuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuwukubeletha ngaphambi kwamaviki angu-37 agcwele.
Ucwaningo lwenziwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukuhlangana kwamazinga e-serum yomama we-selenium, umthofi, kanye nezinki, kanye nokuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Kwakukhona abesifazane abayi-181 kulolu cwaningo lwe-case-control olufakwe ngaphakathi, abayi-90/181 (49.7%) abakhulelwe abakhulelwe isikhathi esigcwele kanye nabayi-91/181 (50.3%) abakhulelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Isilinganiso esiphelele se-serum ye-isileniyamu sasingu-77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, umthofi wawungu-2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L kanti izinki yayingu-0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L ngamareferensi amanani angu-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye no-0.59-1.11 mg/L ngokulandelana.
Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi bekungekho ukushoda kwe-isileniyamu, kanye ne-izinki; kanye nokugxila okuphezulu kwe-i-serum ye-umthofi ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwahlotshaniswa nokwanda kokugxila kwe-serum yomama kumthofi nezinki.
Ukugxila kwe-zinki, umthofi, kanye ne-sileniyamu okuhlotshaniswa nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi

Abacwaningi bathole izinga eliphezulu lama-umsoco odingeka kancane isileniyamu, umthofi, kanye nezinki, kwabesifazane ababe nokuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa basenokungazi ukuthi lezi zinga eziphezulu zivela ekudleni abakudlayo.
Ukuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka uma owesifazane ezala ngaphambi kokuba aqede amasonto angu-37 ekhulelwe.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela emibi yezempilo kumntwana kusukela ekukhubazekeni kokuzalwa kuya ekufeni.
Kungenzeka kube nezimbangela eziningi zokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa indima yokuba khona okuphezulu kwama-umsoco odingeka kancane okutholakala ekudleni nasemvelweni ayaziwa kahle.
Laba msoco odingeka kancane babalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwengane, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani uma kuningi kakhulu kwabo.

Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukukala izinga lesileniyamu, umthofi, kanye nezinki kwabesifazane ababezele ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bese benquma amathuba okuthi ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangelwe izinga eliphezulu ngalinye lomsoco odingeka kancane ocwaningwe.
Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abangu-181 ngemuva kokubeletha ezibhedlela ezimbili eLilongwe, inhlokodolobha yaseMalawi, phakathi kukaJuni 2016 noMashi 2017.
Bathumele amasampula egazi elabhorethri eNorway lapho bakhipha khona i-serum, uhlobo oluhlanzeke kakhudlwana lwegazi, futhi balinganisa amanani esileniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki.
Cishe ingxenye yesigamu yabesifazane abangu-181 ocwaningweni bazale ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi abacwaningi bathole amanani aphezulu kakhulu esileniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki.

Bese belungisa izibalo zabo ukuze babheke ezinye izici eziningi ezifana neminyaka, impilo ejwayelekile, nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze bakhiphe imiphumela ebhekwe ukuthi umsoco odingeka kancane ungaba nayo ekubangeleni ukuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Baphethe ngokuthi amanani amakhulu esileniyamu nethusi awazange adlale indima enkulu ekubangeleni ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa ukuthi amanani aphezulu ezinki andise ingozi yokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngaphezu kokuphindwe izikhathi eziyisithupha.
Inani elikhulu lethusi nokho laliyinkinga kubacwaningi, ngenxa yemiphumela eyaziwayo yobuthi.

Ukuba nabesifazane abangu-181 kuphela abahlanganyela ocwaningweni kwanciphisa ikhono labacwaningi lokuthola kahle izingozi ezihambisana namazinga aphezulu esileniyamu, njengoba inani elilungele kakhulu labahlanganyeli lingu-600.

Izindlela zokudla zansuku zonke zabahlanganyeli azizange zihlolwe ukuthola imithombo engaba khona yezinsoco ezintathu ezidingeka kancane, futhi inkomba yesisindo somzimba (BMI) yabo ayizange ibhalwe phansi.
Lolu ucwaningo lokuqala lolu hlobo olulinganisa imiphumela yesileniyamu, umthofi kanye nezinki kwabesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.

I-Afrika inamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngaphezu kuka-18% uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe aseNtshonalanga angu-5%, ngakho ososayensi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi umsoco udlala indima yini.
Ukuziphatha Kokubuya Ekhaya, Ukuthembeka Endaweni kanye Nobukhosi be-Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) eKenya
Izilwane zibonisa ukuziphatha okukhethekile ngokwendawo nangokwesikhathi okuthuthukisa ukusinda kwazo.
Ukuqonda izindlela zokuziphatha ezinjalo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokonga nokuphatha ngempumelelo ikakhulukazi izinhlobo zezilwane ezisengozini.

Kulolu cwaningo, senza izivivinyo zokuhlola ukuthi i-Pancake tortoise inamandla okubuya ekhaya uma ithuthelwe kwenye indawo futhi siphinde sacwaninga ngokuthembeka endaweni kanye nokuzimela kwalesi silwane ezindaweni zemvelo eKitui County, eKenya.

Ukuziphatha kwezihlangu ezingama-39 ezihlala emifantwini yamadwala ehlukaniswe ngokwendawo eyi-12 kwacwaningwa kusukela ngoJulayi 2020 kuya kuJuni 2022 ngokulandelela ngomsakazo, ukubamba izithombe ngamakhamera kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuhlola kwamaqembu kanye nokuhlola okungahleliwe.
Izifudu eziyishumi nane zafakelwa izidlulisamabhuku zomsakazo futhi zathuthelwa kwezinye izindawo ezikude nezindawo zazo zokuhlala futhi ukuhamba kwazo nokuziphatha kwazo kwaqashwa.

Ngaphandle kwabesifazane ababili kuphela abajwayele kahle izindawo ezintsha zokudluliselwa, zonke ezinye izimfudu zazama ukubuyela ekhaya, kanti u-46.15% wazo wathola indlela yazo ebuyela ezindaweni zazo zasekhaya ngokunemba okukhulu kanti u-15.38% nawo wafinyelela ezindaweni ezikholelwa ukuthi zingaphakathi kwebanga lazo lasekhaya.
Ukubuya ngempumelelo ngaphandle kokungabaza kunikeza ubufakazi bokuthembeka okuqinile endaweni kulezi zinhlobo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokuhlala kwezingwenya emifantwini kwabonisa ukuthi bekungekho mehluko obalulekile wezibalo phakathi kwezinombolo zezingwenya ebezikhona ekuqaleni emifantwini nenombolo emaphakathi ekhona phezu kwezinsuku zokuhlola ezingu-162 (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), okuqhubeka nokusekela ukuthembeka okuqinile kwesizinda kulezi zinhlobo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izenzakalo zokucupha amakhamera kanye nokuhlola okwenziwa ngokukhululekile nakho kufakazele ukuthi izimfudu zePancake zinezindawo zazo lapho abesilisa bezivikela ngolaka ezindaweni zabo kwabanye abesilisa abangenayo.
Izimfudu ezilahlekile ze-pancake zinekhono eliyinqaba lokuthi 'zithole ikhaya'

Abacwaningi benza ukuthola okumangazayo ngenkathi becwaninga ukuziphatha kwe-East African pancake tortoises (Malacochersus tornieri): izilwane ziyakwazi ukuthola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya ngemuva kokuhanjiswa amabanga amade.
Ukuqonda ukuthi benza kanjani futhi kungani benza lokhu kungabaluleka ekongeni lezi zilwane ezihuquzelayo ezingavamile.
Ukuziphatha kokuthola ikhaya lezi zinyoka zasolwandle kubizwa ngokuthi "ukubuya ekhaya", futhi nezinye izilwane eziningi ziyakwazi ukukwenza lokhu.
Ukukwazi ukubuyela ezindaweni ezithile kuvumela izilwane ukuthi zibuyisele ukudla, ozakwabo, kanye nendawo yokuhlala, okuthuthukisa amathuba azo okusinda nokuzala.

Yize ukuziphatha kokubuya ekhaya sekucwaningwe emathutheni olwandle nasemanzini ahlanzekile, abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi sisakwazi kancane ngokubuya ekhaya emathutheni (okuyizilwane eziphila emhlabeni ezifanayo namathutheni).
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ngokuziphatha kwezinyoka zepancake endaweni yazo yemvelo emadwaleni aseKenya.
Bafunda izilwane njengoba zihamba futhi zidla, futhi nalapho ziya kuphumula emifantwini, noma ezikhala zamadwala.
Abacwaningi babheka amaqembu ezimfudu zepanekuku cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi babeka amakhamera ukuze aqophe ividiyo yezilwane uma bengazibheki.
Baphinde banamathisela izidlulisi zomsakazo ezingu-14 ezimfuzisweni.
Lezi amadivayisi amancane avumela abacwaningi ukuthi balandele ukuhamba kwezilwane, futhi baqaphe lapho zichitha khona isikhathi sazo phakathi nosuku nobusuku.
Abacwaningi base beqhubele ezinye zalezi zifudu ezilandelwayo endaweni entsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuzicwaninga kalula.
Kodwa-ke, ngokumangala kwabacwaningi, izimfudu ezimbili zaqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zazo zokuqala, phakathi kuka-1 no-2.5 km ukusuka lapho zazihanjiswe khona.
Yilapho abacwaningi banquma ukuzama ukuhambisa izilwane eziningi kude namakhaya azo, ukuze babone ukuthi zizokhombisa ukuziphatha okufanayo kokubuya ekhaya.

Okuthakazelisayo, cishe ingxenye yesigamu sezimfudu zikwazile ukuthola indlela yokubuyela emifantwini efanayo ababehlala kuyo ngaphambi kokuba bathuthwe, ngokuvamile zihamba ngaphezu kuka-1.5 km ukuze zifike lapho.
Ezinye i-15% zazo zaphumelela ukubuyela endaweni ejwayelekile, kodwa azikwazanga ukuthola umgodi lapho zazithathwe khona ekuqaleni.
Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izikhala ezihlukene ngokuvamile zinezinga elifanayo lezimfudu eziphumula kuzo, okuphakamisa ukuthi izimfudu zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo ukuphumula.
Izithombe ezivela kumakhamera zibuye zikhombise ukuthi izimfudu eziduna zazilwela indawo yazo, kusho ukuthi zazilwa nezinye iziduna ezizama ukungena endaweni yazo noma emifantwini.

Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kungokokuqala ukuthi kubonakale ukuziphatha kokubuya ekhaya kuma-pancake tortoises, futhi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zithanda ukuhlala nokuphumula ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zingakwenza.
Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi izimfudu bezithola kanjani indlela yazo eya ekhaya, ngakho-ke ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli phuzu elibalulekile.
Ngoba izilwane kwesinye isikhathi zidinga ukuthuthelwa ezindaweni ezintsha ukuze zigcinwe, lolu lwazi luzosiza abalondolozi bemvelo ukuthi bagcine izimfudu ziphephile endaweni yazo entsha yokuhlala.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana kososayensi base-Kenya kanye nabaseShayina, futhi luyengeza olwazini lwethu lokuziphatha kokubuya ekhaya kwama-tortoise nezinye izilwane.
Ifamakhokhinethiki yePlasma ye-Rifamisini ye-High-Dose Oral uma kuqhathaniswa neNgokwemithambo ezigulini ezinesifo sofuba seMeningitis:
Ukuhlola Okulawulwayo Okungahleliwe
Imithamo ephakeme ye-rifamisini ngokwemithambo ingase ithuthukise imiphumela ku-meningitis yofuba kodwa ayisebenzi ezindaweni ezinomthwalo omkhulu.

Sasicabanga ukuthi ukuvezwa kwe-rifamisini ku-plasma kuzofana phakathi kokuphathwa ngomlomo kwe-35 mg/kg yesisindo somzimba kanye nokuphathwa ngokwemithambo kwe-20 mg/kg, okuphakanyiswe ukuhlola ukusebenzakahle ku-meningitis yesifo sofuba.
Senze isifundo se-pharmacokinetic esihlelwe ngamaqembu ahlukene esingaphakathi kokuhlola komtholampilo kokwelashwa okwandisiwe kwezilwananhlaselamzimba ze-meningitis yesifo sofuba.
Ababambiqhaza abane-HIV abanesifo sofuba semeningitis baqoqwa ezibhedlela zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlukaniswa ngamaqembu amathathu okuhlukaniswa kwe-rifamisini:
ejwayelekile (ngomlomo 10 mg/kg), umthamo ophakeme (ngomlomo 35 mg/kg), nangokwemithambo (20 mg/kg).
Ukuqoqwa kwamasampula e-pharmacokinetic okukhulu kwenziwa ngosuku lwesithathu.
Ulwazi luchazwe kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziya okungahlukanisiwe, futhi ukuvezwa kwaqhathaniswa ngezilinganiso eziphakathi kwejiyomethri (GMRs).
Ababambiqhaza abangamashumi amane nesithupha bahlolwa isampula ye-pharmacokinetic (umthamo ojwayelekile, n = 17; umthamo ophakeme ngomlomo, n = 15; ngokwemithambo, n = 14).
Inani eliphakathi kwe-CD4 count lalingu-130 amaseli/mm3 (ububanzi be-interquartile [IQR], 66 kuya ku-253 amaseli/mm3).

Indawo ye-rifamisini geometric kusho ngaphansi kwejika lesikhathi sokugxila kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-24 h (AUC0–24) amanani ayengu-42.9mg · h/ml (95% isikhathi sokuqiniseka [CI], 24.5 kuya ku-75.0mg · h/ml) ngomthamo ojwayelekile, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 kuya ku-458.8mg · h/ml) ngomthamo ophakeme womlomo, kanye no-206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 kuya ku-275.8mg · h/ml) ngokwemithambo.

I-rifamisini AUC0–24 GMR yayingu-1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 kuya ku-2.21) kanti ukugxila okuphezulu kwezidakamizwa ku-serum (Cmax) GMR kwakungu-0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 kuya ku-1.23) ngokuphathwa ngomlomo ngomthamo ophakeme maqondana nokuphathwa ngokwemithambo.
I-plasma rifamisini AUC0–24 yayiphezulu ngemuva komthamo womlomo ongu-35-mg/kg kunokuphathwa ngokwemithambo ngomthamo ongu-20-mg/kg ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwelashwa kwesifo sofuba (TB).
Okutholakele kusekela umthamo womlomo we-rifamisini ekuhlolweni kwesifo sofuba semeningitis esizayo.
Amaphilisi anomthamo ophakeme angahlolwa ezigulini ezine-HIV ezinesifo sofuba semeningitis.
Abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi kufanelekile ukuqala ukuhlola ukuthi imithamo ephezulu yalesi sidakamizwa i-rifamisini ingasindisa iziguli ezine-HIV ezinesifo sofuba semeningitis.
Kuze kube abathathu kwabahlanu beziguli ezine-HIV eziphinde zithole i-meningitis yofuba ziyafa ngenxa yalesi sifo, esihlasela uhlelo lwezinzwa.
Abasindile bavame ukushiywa nomonakalo unomphela ohlelweni lwabo lwezinzwa oluphakathi kanye nezinzwa ezibalulekile ezisuka ebuchosheni.
Lokhu kungathinta imizwa yabo nokunyakaza.
Ezinye iziguli ziba nokuquleka noma izifo zokuqina kwemithambo yegazi, noma izingxenye zobuso noma zomzimba zikhubazeka.
I-Rifamisini, umuthi onamandla wokulwa namagciwane osetshenziswa ngokumelene nesifo sofuba, ngokuvamile unikezwa njengekhasule ukuze kuzanywe ukubulala amagciwane abangela i-meningitis yesifo sofuba.
Iziguli ezigula kakhulu zivame ukuthola kunzima ukugwinya amaphilisi.
IRifamisini inganikezwa nangokwemithambo (emithanjeni) ngendlela yoketshezi.
Inaliti ifakwa emithanjeni yegazi yesiguli ukuze uketshezi lukhululwe emzimbeni.
Azikho izivivinyo ezisake zenziwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi umzimba wesiguli uthatha kanjani umuthi uma kusetshenziswa le ndlela.
Ukwelashwa ngokwemithambo kudinga imishini eminingi, ukuhlala esibhedlela kanye nempilo yabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe abazi ukuthi bangafaka kanjani inaliti ngokwemithambo ngendlela efanele.
Ngakho-ke akuyona inketho ezindaweni zomhlaba ezinenzuzo encane yezinsiza.
Odokotela base beyazi ukuthi i-rifamisini ayingeni kahle emanzini asebuchosheni, emgogodleni nasekhanda, okuyizindawo lapho amagciwane angacasha khona.
Yingakho kudingeka izilinganiso eziphezulu (inani) ukuze kubulawe ngempumelelo wonke amagciwane emzimbeni wesiguli.
Kodwa abacwaningi bebengaqiniseki ukuthi umthamo ophakeme ungaba kanjani usebenza kahle futhi uphephile.

Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom babefuna ukuthola, besebenzisa inani elincane leziguli, ukuthi kuphephile yini ukunikeza imithamo ephezulu yerifamisini noma njengekhasipuli noma ngokwemithambo, nokuthi imizimba yabo izoyamukela kanjani inguqulo ngayinye.
Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu ngaphambi kokuba abanye abacwaningi baqale ukuhlola okukhulu, noma ama-test, lapho behlela ukunikeza iziguli eziningi izilinganiso eziphezulu ze-rifamisini.
Omunye wamalungiselelo amathathu okwelashwa nge-rifamisini wanikezwa iziguli ezingama-46 zaseNingizimu Afrika ezine-HIV ezinesifo sofuba semeningitis.
Eyokuqala kwakuwukwelashwa okujwayelekile kwamakhasiphulethi okwamanje anikezwa iziguli, okungama-10mg erifamisini ngekhilogremu ngayinye isisindo sesiguli.
Elinye iqembu lathola amaphilisi anomthamo ophakeme we-35 milligrams ngekhilogramu yesisindo sesiguli.
Iqembu lesithathu lamukela ngokwemithambo amamiligremu angama-20 ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu.
Amasampula egazi athathwa ezigulini ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Abacwaningi babe sebebala ukuthi ingakanani i-rifamisini eyayikhona ku-uketshezi lwegazi labo (ingxenye ewuketshezi yegazi).
Kutholakale rifamisini eningi emizimbeni yeziguli ezathola amaphilisi anedosi ephezulu kunalabo abathole ukwelashwa ngokwemithambo noma idosi ejwayelekile.
Ukugxila kwalesi sidakamizwa ku-uketshezi lwegazi kwakufana kumthamo ophakeme kanye nokwelashwa ngokwemithambo.
Lezi zinhlayiya zaziphakeme kunalapho iziguli zithola umthamo ojwayelekile kuphela.
Ngokombono wabacwaningi, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo yeziguli ezihlushwa yi-tuberculosis meningitis ingathuthukiswa uma zithola imithamo ephezulu ye-rifamisini.
Akubalulekile ukuthi bayithola njengezibhebhe noma ngokwemithambo - okubalulekile ukuthi bathole imithamo ephezulu, ngoba izidumbu zabo ziyakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lalo.
Imiphumela isekela okutholakele kokuhlola okwenziwe e-Uganda nase-Indonesia.
Izivivinyo ezimbili ezincane e-Indonesia isibonelo ziphakamise ukuthi izimpilo zeziguli eziningi zingasindiswa uma zinikezwa imithamo ephezulu ye-rifamisini ngokomlomo noma ngokwemithambo.
Ngeshwa, abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi abahlanganyeli abambalwa abathatheke kulesi sifundo kunalokho ababekulindele ekuqaleni, okungenzeka kube nomthelela emiphumeleni yabo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe eNingizimu Afrika.
Kusekela uhlelo lokuqhuba ukuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi kuwufanele yini ukunikeza iziguli ze-HIV ezinesifo sofuba semeningitis imithamo ephezulu ye-rifamisini.
Kuyethemba ukuthi ukwelashwa okunjalo kuzolondoloza izimpilo zabantu abaningi e-Afrika nakwezinye izindawo zomhlaba lapho i-meningitis ye-tuberculosis iyinkinga enkulu.
Ingabe ukufakwa komquba kanye ne-ilahlemlotha kungathuthukisa izinga lenhlabathi ye-savanna esogwini esonakele kakhulu?
Ukuncipha kokuvunda komhlabathi kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhiqizeni izitshalo emazweni asezansi yeSahara.
Umphumela omuhle wokusetshenziswa kwe-ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba ekuthuthukiseni umvundisi wenhlabathi ubikiwe ngababhali abaningi.

Kulolu cwaningo, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kwe-incubation yelabhorethri yezinsuku ezingama-30 kusetshenziswa amasampula angu-120 g ngalinye le-Haplic acrisol elungiswe nge-corn cob ilahlemlotha (cbio), rice husk ilahlemlotha (rbio), coconut husk ilahlemlotha (coco300 kanye coco700) noma umquba wezinkukhu (umquba); kanye ne-co-composted rice husk ilahlemlotha (rcocomp) noma i-co-composted corn cob ilahlemlotha (cococomp) ngezinga le-1 % w/w ukulungiswa: umhlabathi, ngokulandelana.

Ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ocwaningweni zahlanganiswa umquba wezinkukhu kanye ne-corn cob ilahlemlotha noma i-rice husk ilahlemlotha (1% umquba + 1% ilahlemlotha: 1% umhlabathi w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola imiphumela yazo ekuphefumuleni okuyisisekelo komhlabathi, i-pH yomhlabathi; ikhabhoni yemicrobial yomhlabathi; amandla okushintshana nge-cation; ikhabhoni ephelele ye-organic, inani eliphelele le-nitrogen kanye nokugxila kwe-nitrogen etholakalayo.
Ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba asetshenziswa wodwa noma ndawonye, kanye ne-biochar ehlanganisiwe yakhuphula i-pH yenhlabathi ngamayunithi angu-0.28–2.29 uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula okungaguquki.

Ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo okuvela kumquba kuphela noma umquba wezinhlamvu zerayisi, noma ilahlemlotha lekhoba likakolweni noma inhlanganisela yelahlemlotha nomquba kwakuphakeme kunokulawula okungaguquki, okwakufana nalokho okuvela ekwelashweni ngelahlemlotha kuphela.
I-TOC kumquba wedwa kanye nokwelashwa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-corn cob ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba bekuphakeme ngo-37% no-117%, ngokulandelana, kunokulawula.

Ukusetshenziswa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-ilahlemlotha yezikhwebu zelayisi kanye nomquba kwandise i-MBC ngo-132% kanti ukufakwa komquba kuphela kwandise i-MBC ngo-247%, ngokulandelana, uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula.

Ekuphetheni, ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komquba kuphela noma ngokuhlanganiswa ne-ilahlemlotha, noma i-biochar e-composted kuthuthukise imingcele yekhwalithi yenhlabathi efana ne-pH yenhlabathi kanye ne-MBC, futhi kwakhuthaza ukuzinza kwe-C yenhlabathi ngokwandisa i-TOC nokunciphisa ukulahleka kwe-C yenhlabathi ngokunciphisa ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo.
Ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba kuthuthukisa iqophelo lenhlabathi lezitshalo

Lolu cwaningo luphande ukuthi ilahlemlotha, impahla ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni eyenziwe nge-biomass elahliwe, ingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuthuthukisa izinga lezinhlabathi e-Afrika ezansi nesahara.
Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ilahlemlotha lithuthukisa izinga lenhlabathi ngendlela efanayo nezindlela ezihlukile ezibiza kakhulu futhi ezingatholakali kalula.
Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nokukhiqizwa kwezolimo e-zansi nesahara Afrika ukwehla kokuvunda komhlabathi.
Iqophelo elingcono lenhlabathi lingaholela ezivunweni zezitshalo ezingcono, okunganciphisa ubumpofu basemakhaya futhi kubuyisele emuva ukonakala kwemithombo yemvelo.
Ucwaningo luveze ukuthi ilahlemlotha, impahla ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa ukuvundisa komhlabathi.
Ilahlemlotha iyimiphumela yokushisa izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, ebukhoneni bokungabi khona kwe-oksijini noma okuncane.
Kuboniswe ukuthi ilahlemlotha / i-biochar yandisa indawo engaphezulu yomhlaba, yandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi nomoya, futhi ivuselele izilwanyana ezincane emhlabathini.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolile umphumela we-ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba ekwaneliseni komhlaba kusetshenziswa izinkomba ezifana nokuphefumula komhlaba, i-pH yomhlaba, ukuba khona kwamagciwane, inani lekhabhoni, nenani le-nitrogen etholakalayo.

Abacwaningi bakhiqize ama-biochar e-corn cob, ukhakhayi lwekhokhonathi kanye ne-husk yerayisi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis, ebandakanya ukufudumeza izinto eziphilayo ngaphandle kwe-oksijini, ku-450 °C esithandweni esikhiqizwe endaweni.
Abacwaningi bakhiqiza ilahlemlotha ye-coconut husk besebenzisa iphilolayisisi ku-300 °C naku-700 °C.
Abacwaningi base bebhaka amasampula enhlabathi ahlanganiswe namalahlemlotha izinsuku ezingu-30.

Isampula ngalinye lalinezinto ezikhethekile zomhlabathi ezibizwa ngokuthi i-Haplic acrisol, ezazixutshwe nezinhlanganisela ezahlukene zamalahlemlotha ezenziwe ngekhoba likakolweni, ikhoba lerayisi noma ikhoba likakhukhunathi, kanye nomquba wezinkukhu.
Ezinye izampula zaziqukethe inhlanganisela yomhlabathi nomquba wezinkukhu, ne-ilahlemlotha yesikhwebu serayisi, kanye ne-ilahlemlotha yombhila, ngokulandelana.
Isampula ngalinye laline-1% umquba, 1% ye-biochar ngayinye, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuhlola umphumela wokuxutshwa ngakunye kwekhwalithi yomhlabathi.

Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi ukufaka ilahlemlotha kanye nomquba enhlabathini, kungaba ngokuhlukana noma ngokuhlangene, kwandisa inani le-pH lenhlabathi kusuka ku-0.28–2.29 amayunithi e-pH, uma kuqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engaxutshwe.
Ukukhuphuka kwe-pH kusho ukuthi inhlabathi ibe manzi kancane.

Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa umhlabathi, kwanda lapho kufakwa umquba kuphela, noma lapho umquba uhlanganiswa neqhwa lerayisi, noma ilahlemlotha lekhoba likakolweni noma ilahlemlotha elihlanganisiwe.

Amasampula omhlaba abonise ukwanda kokuqukethwe kwekhabhoni ye-organic ephelele ngo-37% lapho kusetshenziswa umquba kuphela, kanye nokwanda ngo-117% lapho ilahlemlotha le-corn cob lihlanganiswa nomquba.

Inani lomsebenzi wezinto ezincane eziphilayo landa ngo-132% lapho umhlabathi ubenenhlanganisela yomquba kanye nelahlemlotha lezinhlamvu zerayisi, kuqhathaniswa nokwanda ngo-247% emasampuleni omhlabathi abenawo umquba kuphela.
Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ikhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukwehlisa ubuningi be-asidi emhlabathini kusetshenziswa ilahlemlotha, elitholakala kalula futhi ngentengo ephansi.
Lokhu kuhluke kumkhuba ohlukile wokufaka i-lime emhlabathini, okudulayo futhi okungatholakali kalula kubalimi abancane basezansi nesahara e-Afrika.
Inethiwekhi Yezinhlayiya Zefibrin Ezingajwayelekile Esifweni Samathambo Nokuhlobana Kwayo Nokuhlaselwa Kwamasosha Omzimba, Ukuvuvukala Nokubunjwa Kwegazi
Ingozi yezigameko zemithambo yegazi ezigulini ezine-RA ikhuphuka ngokweqile ngenxa yokuvuvukala okuhambisana nomzimba wonke.
Umphumela ohlobene nokuhlaselwa kwamasosha omzimba ekwakhiweni nasekutheni i-fibrin(ogen) ingadala izinkinga zokuvuvukala usazokwaziwa.

Ngakho-ke, saqhathanisa izinkomba zomsebenzi wemithambo yegazi, ukuvuvukala, ukujiya kwegazi kanye nokwakheka kwefayibrini ezigulini ze-RA nezilawuli ezinempilo futhi sahlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkomba.
Kwathathwa amasampula egazi ezigulini ezingama-30 ze-RA kanye nabazithandela abaphile kahle abangama-25 abalingana ngeminyaka nobulili.
Amazinga e-SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 kanye ne-VCAM-1 akalwa kusetshenziswa i-sandwich immunoassay.
Ukuqina kwegazi eliphelele kwahlolwa kusetshenziswa i-Thromboelastography.
Amanethiwekhi amafayibha e-fibrin kanye nesakhiwo sefayibha kwahlolwa kusetshenziswa i-Scanning Electron Microscopy.
Ukutholwa nokulinganiswa kwe-citrullination kumathumba e-fibrin akhiwe kwenziwa kusetshenziswa i-Citrulline monoclonal antibody enelebuli ye-fluorescent nge-Confocal Microscopy.
Ukugxila kwe-SAA, CRP kanye ne-ICAM-1 bekuphakeme kakhulu ezigulini ze-RA uma kuqhathaniswa nezilawuli.

Imingcele ye-TEG ephathelene nokuqala kokuhlangana kwegazi (R no-K), izinga lokuxhumana kwe-fibrin (i-α-Angle), nesikhathi sokufinyelela ekukhiqizeni i-thrombus enkulu (i-TMRTG) bekuncishisiwe ezigulini ze-RA.
Imingcele ephathelene namandla okuqina kwegazi (MA, MRTG, TGG) ayizange ihluke ngokwezibalo phakathi kwe-RA nezilawuli.
Ukumodela kwe-logistic regression kwembula ukuhlotshaniswa okuqinile phakathi kwama-acute phase reactants (CRP, SAA) nemingcele ye-TEG kunamaphawu omsebenzi we-endothelial.

Ukuhlaziywa kwe-microscopic kuveze amanethiwekhi aminyene wezinhlayiya ze-fibrin ezinkulu ezigulini ze-RA uma kuqhathaniswa nezilawuli [isilinganiso (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm ngokulandelana, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
Ukutholwa kwezigaba eziningi ezine-citrulline ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo ze-fibrin clot ezigulini ze-RA, okwakungavamile kumasampuli okulawula (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Iziguli ezine-RA esebenzayo zibonisa iphrofayili yokuhlangana kwegazi ehluke kakhulu kunokutholakala okuvamile okuhlotshaniswa nezinye izimo zokuvuvukala.

Ukuguqulwa kwezakhiwo zamaprotheni ngokuhlangene nokuhlaselwa amasosha omzimba nge-citrullination kungadlala indima ekunqumeni isakhiwo se-fibrin kanye namathuba okwandisa ubungozi be-thrombotic ezigulini ze-RA.
Ukujiya kwegazi ezigulini ezine-arthritis kungachaza amathuba abo andile okuba nesifo senhliziyo, isifo sohlangothi.
Ucwaningo olusha mayelana nesifo samathambo selunikeze ukuqonda okungcono kokuxhumana okungenzeka phakathi kwalesi simo nokwanda kobungozi besifo senhliziyo.
Isifo samathambo (RA) yisifo esizivelelayo samasosha omzimba esibuhlungu nesikhubazayo, esihambisana nokuqubuka kwamalunga kanye nasemzimbeni wonke.

Sekuyisikhathi eside ososayensi bazi ukuthi abaphethwe yilesi sifo baphinde babe nengozi ephakeme ngo-50% yemiphumela yesifo senhliziyo nemithambo yegazi (CVD) – njengokushaywa unhlangothi noma ukuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo.
Isici esibalulekile kuleyo ngozi umphumela ukuvuvukala onawo enqubweni yokujiya kwegazi.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenye lobu budlelwano, ukuthola ukuthi kungani ngempela i-RA yandisa ubungozi be-CVD.
Ngokucacile, abacwaningi bahlola imiphumela yokuvuvukala nezinguquko zesakhiwo kumaprotheni athile ahlobene nokuhlangana kwegazi, abizwa ngokuthi ama-fibrin.

Lawa maphrotheni avele njengezixhumanisi ezinde ezakha "umsebenzi wamanetha" oyisisekelo wezicubu zegazi, ngakho noma yiziphi izinguquko kuma-fibrins ngokwawo zingaba nemiphumela emibi yenqubo yokubopha igazi iyonke.
Abacwaningi baqhathanise amasampula egazi eziguli ze-RA namasampula avela kubantu abaphilile.
Kuzo zonke izimo, abacwaningi babefuna "omaka" egazini abakhombisa ukuvuvukala, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingajwayelekile enqubweni evamile yokuhlangana kwegazi okungakhulisa ingozi ye-CVD.
Amahlulelo ngokwawo ahlaziywa ngaphansi kwesibonakhulu, ukuze kutholakale noma yiziphi izinguquko esakhiweni samaprotheni awo e-fibrin.

Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi izigaxa zegazi ezigulini ze-RA zakheka ngokushesha kunalezo ezitholakala kubantu abaphilile, futhi izintambo zamaprotheni ezazenziwe ngazo zaziminyene kakhulu kunamafibrin ajwayelekile.
Kube nezinguquko nakwizakhamzimba ezakha amaprotheni e-fibrin, okwaholela ekutheni ziqale impendulo yokulwa nezifo yomzimba, okuholele ekuvuvukaleni okwengeziwe.
Abanye abacwaningi baye baqaphela izinguquko esakhiweni samino acid samafibrin emalungeni eziguli ze-RA ngaphambili, kodwa lokhu kungokokuqala abacwaningi bebona umphumela ofanayo egazini.

Kuhlanganiswe nezinye izinguquko ezibonwa kumaqhina egazi, abakutholile kungasiza ososayensi ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda okujulile kobudlelwano phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD, nokuthi bangabubona kanjani izimpawu zokuqala zalezi zifo.
Nakuba le miphumela yokuqala ithembisa, kufanelekile ukuqaphela ukuthi usayizi wesampula wocwaningo wawuncane uma kuqhathaniswa.

Abacwaningi baphinde basho ukuthi indlela abayisebenzisile ukuthola izinguquko zama-amino acid kumaprotheni ingase ibe ithole imiphumela evela ezintweni ezingahlangene, kusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ama-test akhethekile okuqondiwe ama-fibrin ukuze kuqinisekiswe umphumela esikhathini esizayo.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqonda izixhumanisi eziyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kwe-RA kanye nokwanda komngcipheko we-CVD kungathuthukisa imiphumela yeziguli ze-RA njengoba sifunda ukubona nokwelapha lezi zifo ngempumelelo enkulu.
Abacwaningi abavela eNingizimu Afrika, eDenmark nakwelase-Mbusweni WamaNgisi babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo, oluxhaswe yi-South African Medical Research Council.
Izibikezelo zesimo sezulu solwandle kubasebenzisi basogwini – imibono, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokwamukelwa
Ucwaningo lwamanje luhlose ukubhekana nokungaxhumani phakathi kwesayensi nomphakathi ngendlela yokungahambisani okungenzeka ekunikezelweni nasekufunweni kolwazi okwaziwa njengegebe lokusetshenziswa.
Kuleli cala, sihlola ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezulu lolwandle (mithoshini) njengoba lubonwa ngabasebenzisi emazweni amabili aseNingizimu Nenkabazwe:
INingizimu Afrika neNew Zealand.
Lapha, ukugxila akukhona kuphela ekubonisweni, ekusebenzisweni nasekuthathweni kwezibikezelo zezigameko ezishubile kodwa kugxile ekubambeni iqhaza kwezibikezelo ezijwayelekile, ezivamile.
Ucwaningo lwenziwa ngokusebenzisa inhlolovo, eyakhelwe phezu kwemibuzo emithathu yocwaningo.

Imibuzo yocwaningo ihlanganisa izihloko ezisukela ekubikezeleni amathuluzi e-ergonomics, ukunemba nokungaguquguquki, ukusetshenziswa, isithunzi sezikhungo, kanye nokungaqiniseki okuhlobene nenguquko yobunjalozwe (ukukhuluma nje ezimbalwa).
Uhlu lwemibuzo oluku-inthanethi lwasabalaliswa kabanzi ukufaka abasebenzisi bezokuzijabulisa nabathengisa.
Ucwaningo lugxile ekutholeni izindlela zokwenza izinqumo ezingaba khona ezithinta izidingo zolwazi zabantu abasebenzisa ulwandle olusogwini ngendlela ehlukile.

Ukuhlaziywa kokuvumelana kwamasiko (CCA) kwasetshenziswa ukuhlola ukuqonda okwabiwe kanye nokwehluka kwemibono ngaphakathi kweqembu eliphelele labaphendulile kanye nakumaqembu amancane asekelwe emikhakheni nasezindaweni zamazwe.

Sithole amazinga ahlukahlukene okuvumelana eqenjini lonke (abathathi-nxaxheba abavela kuzo zombili izizwe nakuzo zonke izigaba ezihlanganisiwe) uma kuqhathaniswa namaqembu amancane ahlukene wabasebenzisi.

Bonke ababambiqhaza abathathwe ndawonye babonise ukuvumelana okuphakathi nendawo ngokwesiko mayelana nezindaba ezethulwe kodwa kunezinguquko ezithile emibonweni ezingeni lezwe, okuphakamisa amasiko angaphansi angaba khona.

Ukuhlaziya amaqembu amancane ezwe kanye nezamabhizinisi ngokwehlukana, sithole ukuvumelana okucacile kwesiko eqenjini labasebenzisi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana okuqinile kungakhathalekile ukuthi bangabaphi emikhakheni.
Iqembu labasebenzisi bezohwebo base-New Zealand belinokuvumelana okuncane kakhulu nawo wonke amanye amaqembu amancane.
Sihlinzeka ngengxoxo ngemithelela evela kutholwe kwethu ngezinto ezibalulekile ekuthathweni kwezinsiza ngakho-ke ekukhiqizeni izibikezelo ezivelele.
Izinto eziningi ezibalulekile zezibikezelo ezisuselwe kwesayensi esikhathini esizayo nazo zibonakala, kucatshangelwa imithelela elindelekile yenguquko yobunjalozwe.
Siphetha ngokuphakamisa umdwebo womqondo ukuze kugqanyiswe ukusebenzisana okubalulekile phakathi kokuthuthukiswa ngokuhlanganyela kwemikhiqizo yokubikezela nokunemba/ukuvumelana kwesayensi.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, abaseNew Zealand bathembela ezibikezelweni zezulu olwandle

Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nabaseNew Zealand abasebenza nabahlala ezindaweni ezisogwini bathembele ezinsizeni zezibikezelo zesimo sezulu ezilula ukuzisebenzisa, futhi ezihlala zinikeza izibikezelo ezinembile.
Izinsizakalo zokubikezela zesizwe kanye namawebhusayithi ahlukahlukene ezentengiso ahlinzeka ngezibikezelo mayelana nokuthi isimo sezulu sizoba yini.
Bazama ukuba banembe futhi balusizo ngangokunokwenzeka.
Inqwaba yesayensi nokucabanga kwesayensi kungena kulezi zibikezelo.

Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bakhethe ukubheka ukuthi abantu eNingizimu Afrika naseNew Zealand basebenzisa kanjani izinsiza zokubikezela – womabili la mazwe anogwini olude, kodwa anabantu bendawo abahlukahlukene kakhulu nezimo zasogwini ezihlukile.

Babefuna ukuthola ukuthi lezi zakhini zasogwini zisebenzisa kangaki izinsiza zokubikezela zikazwelonke noma ezentengiso, ngezizathu zini nokuthi ngabe zithole lezi zinsiza ziwusizo futhi zithembekile yini.
Lezi yizici ezibalulekile maqondana nokuthi inguquko yobunjalozwe yesikhathi esizayo ingase ithinte kanjani ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu.
Umbhalomibuzo we-inthanethi waphendulwa ngabantu abangu-31 baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabangu-126 baseNew Zealand.

Laba bahlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngezinhloso zomsebenzi (isibonelo abadobi kanye nezinhlangano zokucinga nokuhlenga), nabanye abahlanganyela kwezemidlalo nezokungcebeleka ezihlobene nolwandle ezifana nokuntweza, ukugwedla, noma ukubhukuda.
Abacwaningi babuza ngokuthi kulula kangakanani ukusebenzisa insiza yokubikezela isimo sezulu abayithandayo, nokuthi izibikezelo zayo zinembile futhi ziyahambisana kangakanani.
Ababambiqhaza babhale phansi izici ezenza kube usizo futhi kubaluleke kubo futhi bathi ukuthi lezi zinto zingase zishintshe ngenxa yenguquko yobunjalozwe.
Baphinde kwadingeka ukuthi bathi bayethemba yini ulwazi olunikezwa izinsiza zezulu zikazwelonke, nokuthi bazizwa kanjani ngalo.
Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlanganyela ocwaningweni bekuwabadwebi bamaza, noma abantu abasiza ngemisebenzi yokusesha nokuhlenga noma amaphrojekthi ocwaningo.
Iningi labaNew Zealand abaphendule imibuzo babheka izibikezelo zezulu ngoba babefuna ukuya ukudoba, ukuhamba ngesikebhe noma ukuhamba ngomkhumbi olwandle.
Ababambiqhaza abavela kuwo womabili amazwe bathembela kulwazi olunikezwe kubo yizinsizakalo zesimo sezulu zikazwelonke.
Babekhetha izinsizakalo zokubikezela ezinembayo, ezihambisanayo, ezilula ukuzisebenzisa futhi ezinezici ezingaguqulwa ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zabo.
Ababambiqhaza abasebenzise le sevisi ngezinhloso zomsebenzi ngokujwayelekile bathole ukuthi izibikezelo zezimo osebeni eziseduze nogu bezingakanembi ngokwanele.
Ulwazi lwezinye izindawo lwalunembile kakhulu kunezinye.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavame ukusebenzisa izinsiza zezulu kaningi kunabantu baseNew Zealand, futhi babheka okungenani kanye ngosuku.
Kwabangu-9 kwabangu-10 abaphendulile, uhlelo lokubikezela oluhle kakhulu lwalubaluleke kakhulu.
Abaningi bakhetha insizakalo ebibheka izinsuku ezintathu kuya kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa esikhathini esizayo.
Abantu abasebenza ezolimo zamanzi noma ababehlela izimo eziphuthumayo ezingenzeka babefuna izibikezelo zesikhathi eside nezesizini.

Iningi labasebenzisi likholelwa ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kwenguquko yobunjalozwe, izinsiza zokubikezela zizodinga ukusebenzisa ulwazi olusekelwe kwesayensi olungcono kakhulu esikhathini esizayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izibikezelo ezinembile.
Izifundo ezinjalo ezimbalwa kakhulu ezake zenziwa emazweni aseNingizimu Nenkabazwe.
Abacwaningi banethemba lokuthi bakwazile ukufunda okwanele kubahlanganyeli ngokusekelwe emibuzweni abababuza yona.
Ubuthakathaka obungase bube khona futhi ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlala eNew Zealand kunaseNingizimu Afrika babambe iqhaza ocwaningweni.
Umsebenzi wabo uzosiza abantu abasebenzela izinsiza zokubikezela isimo sezulu ukuthi baklame imikhiqizo engcono egcina izidingo zamakhasimende abo engqondweni.
Bazokwazi ukwenza ukuthuthukiswa nezinguquko ngokusekelwe ekwanelisekeni kwamakhasimende abo nokuthi kungani bewasebenzisa.
Indlela Yokubamba Iqhaza Ekulinganiseni Ukuhlakanipha Kwesimo Sezulu Kwezokungenelela Kwezolimo:
Udaba lweLushoto
Umqondo we-Climate-smart Agriculture (CSA) uya uthola amandla emhlabeni wonke.
Nokho, akucacile ukuthi yini okufanele ihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwezinsika zayo ezintathu—ukukhiqiza, amandla okuvuka uzibuthe kanye nokunciphisa umthelela.
Ngakho-ke, i-CSA ihlanganisa izinqubo/ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene bezolimo, okwenza kube nzima ukubeka phambili izinhloso ze-CSA.
Okokuqala, kunokuntuleka kwezindlela ezicacile nezisebenzisekayo kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ukuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu kokungenelela.
Okwesibili, kunolwazi oluncane olukhona mayelana nomthelela wokungenelela okuhlukahlukene okusevele kukhuthazwe njenge-CSA, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni osathuthuka.
Ekugcineni, ukubekwa phambili kwe-CSA akubheki imibono yababambe iqhaza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungenelela kuyasebenza, kufanele futhi kunamandla amakhulu okwamukelwa.
Lapha, sichaza umthetho omusha wokubamba iqhaza wokuhlola ukuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu kokungenelela kwezolimo emikhubeni yabalimi abancane.
Lokhu kuhlonza izinkomba zezinga lepulazi (nezinkomba) zezinsika zokutholakala kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ze-CSA.
Kuphinde kusekele ukuhlolwa kokubamba iqhaza kwezinkomba, okuvumela ukuthi kwenziwe izilinganiso zesisekelo nezokuhlola ikusasa lobuhlakani besimo sezulu.
Uhlelo lwavivinywa phakathi kwabalimi abangu-72 abenza izinhlobo ezahlukene zokungenelela kwe-CSA edolobhaneni elihlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu iLushoto, eTanzania.

Abalimi babaluleka kakhulu ukungenelela okuthuthukisa umvundiso nenhlaka yenhlabathi, kunciphise ukugeleza kwamanzi ebusweni, futhi kubuyisele umhlaba owonakele ngenxa yemiphumela emihle esivunweni nasekulimeni izitshalo ngaphandle kwesikhathi sokuvuna.
Ikakhulu, ukungenelela kwe-CSA kukhuphule ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukukhiqizwa kokudla, ukusetshenziswa nemali engenayo.
Inqubo kulula ukuyivumelanisa nezifunda ezahlukene nezinhlelo zokulima futhi ivumela ukubekwa phambili okungcono kokungenelela.
Kodwa sincoma ukuthi i-CSA yamukelwe njengengxenye yenqubo yokuhlola, ukuhlola nokufunda.
Izindlela ezintsha zokuhlola zisiza ososayensi nabalimi ukulungiselela inguquko yobunjalozwe.
Ososayensi abasebenza nabalimi eTanzania manje sebengakwazi ukukala ukuthi imikhuba emisha yokulima isebenza kahle kangakanani ekunciphiseni imiphumela yokuguquka kobunjalozwe.
Bathemba ukuthi indlela yabo izothuthukisa ukutholakala kokudla kanye nezivuno zezitshalo kubalimi kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba futhi.
“I-Climate-smart Agriculture” yinto iZizwe Ezihlangene ezikhuthaza yona ukusiza abalimi abancane ukuthi bazilungiselele inguquko yobunjalozwe.
Umlimi ohlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu uyakwazi ukuvumelana nezimo zezulu ezishintshayo futhi uyakwazi ukwandisa ukutholakala kokudla ngokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo.
Lolu udaba olubalulekile kubalimi baseTanzania, njengoba izwe selivele libhekene nezivuno eziphansi zezitshalo ezibalulekile zokusanhlamvu ngenxa yokuguquka kobunjalozwe.

Kodwa, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukukala impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, njengokusebenzisa umquba, futhi abalimi ngokwabo abahlale bebuziwe ukuthi ukungenelela kuyasebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe.

Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuklama indlela yokukala impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, ngokugxila okukhethekile ekuthuthukiseni ukutholakala kokudla kanye nokuvumelana nezimo.
Ukuqala, bafunda ezinye izifundo zezolimo futhi bakhiqiza izinhlu ezi-2 ezihlanganisa izici eziyi-14, noma "izinkomba", ezibalulekile ekulinganiseni ukutholakala kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
Bese, besebenza esifundeni saseLushoto eTanzania, abacwaningi basebenzisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe bezolimo abaningana ukuze bakhombe izinkomba ezibaluleke kakhulu ohlwini ngalunye.
Abalimi babona ukukhiqizwa kokudla njengesikhombisi esibaluleke kakhulu sokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla.
Ngamanye amazwi, noma yikuphi ukungenelela okuthuthukisa isivuno sezitshalo zabo kwakubaluleke kakhulu.

Khonamanjalo, ngohlangothi lokuvumelana nezimo, abalimi babenentshisekelo ikakhulukazi ekungeneleleni okwakubasiza ukuvikela inhlabathi yamapulazi abo, nalokho okwakuthuthukisa ulwazi lwabo, amakhono, nemali engenayo.
Lapho abacwaningi sebebonile ukubaluleka kwenkomba ngayinye, bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ukuze bahlolwe ukuthi izinhlobo eziyisithupha zokungenelela eLushoto zaziphumelele yini.
Kuzo zonke izimo, babuza abalimi bendawo, esikalini esingu-1 kuya ku-5, ukuthi ngabe kube nokwanda yini esikhombisweni ngasinye kusukela ukungenelela kuqale.
Lokhu kubavumele ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokungenelela ebezinomthelela oqinile ekutholakaleni kokudla nasekuzivumelaniseni nezimo.
Bathole ukuthi kuphela okungenelela okungu-3 kokungu-6 okusetshenziswayo okwakunomthelela wangempela.
Lezo kwakuwukwenza umquba, izinhlobo zezitshalo ezikwazi ukumelana nesomiso, nokuhlinzeka ngokudla okungcono kwezilwane zokudla.

Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungenelela kwesikhathi esizayo kuhlangabezana nezidingo zabalimi baseLushoto kanye nezinhloso zezolimo ezihlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.
Banezela ukuthi ukukhetha ukungenelela okufanele nakho kwandisa amathuba okuthi abalimi batusa imikhuba emihle kubakhelwane babo, ngaleyo ndlela basakaze imibono ehlakaniphile yesimo sezulu.

Ngokubanzi, le ndlela ingasetshenziswa nakwezinye izifunda, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu ahlakaniphile esimo sezulu athatha izimo zendawo nolwazi lwabalimi ngokubheka okuqhubekayo nokuhlola.
Ngokwenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zezolimo ezihlakaniphile zesimo sezulu kungenzeka zibe yimpumelelo futhi zithole ukwesekwa, kokubili eThanzaniya nakwezinye izindawo e-Afrika.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana kososayensi base-Kenya kanye neNetherlands.
Izimbangazifo Zezilwane Ezinomgogodla Njengezilwane Ezihlaselayo: Ukuqonda Okuvela eNingizimu Afrika
Ucwaningo lwezinhlayiya zezifo njengohlobo lwezilwane nezitshalo zokufika ezihlaselayo alukatholi ukunakwa okukhulu emkhakheni wesayensi yokuhlasela.
Izimbangazifo ezingenisiwe zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezintweni eziphilayo, ezemvelo abahlala kuzo, kanye nezomnotho ezisekelwa yilezo zemvelo.

Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezigameko zezifo ezafika ezilwaneni ezifuywayo nezilwane zasendle (amarabi ezinja, isifo sofuba sezinkomo, kanye nesifo somkhuhlane wezinkomo) kanye nabantu (isifo somkhuhlane omncane, isifo sokuhlaza kanye ne-virus yesandulela ngculaza, i-HIV) ukukhombisa izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zimbangazifo ezingaba nayo.

Umthelela omkhulu kakhulu kuze kube manje wawungowesifo se-rinderpest, esabangela ukufa kwezigidi zezinkomo, futhi sacishe saqeda izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu esakhiweni nasekusebenzeni kwezemvelo.
Isifo se-rinderpest sesiqediwe emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa amarabi ezinja kanye nesifo sofuba lwezinkomo kusasele, futhi ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuphathwa kuzodingeka ukuze kuvinjwe.
Kwezifo zabantu, isifo somkhuhlane wesikhumba naso sesiqothulwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa umthelela walesi sifo, esalethwa ngabahlali baseYurophu, wawubhubhisa kakhulu.

Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1700, ingxenye enkulu (kuze kufike ku-90% kwezinye izindawo) yabantu bomdabu be-Khoekhoe yashona, kwabhujiswa isiko nendlela yabo yokuphila, kwashiywa abasindile abambalwa ukuba baqashwe njengabasebenzi basemapulazini.
I-HIV, eyatholakala okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982 nayo ibe nemiphumela emikhulu futhi ukwelashwa ngama-antiretroviral okwamanje kubiza uhulumeni u-ZAR 66.4 billion ngonyaka.
Siphinde sifake i-West Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo ezavela e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni wonke.
Sibikezela ukuthi izifo ezintsha zizovela njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwandisa indawo yabo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba ivolumu yokuhweba inyuka.
Lokho ososayensi abakuziyo ngabalimazayo abancane ababangela izifo eNingizimu Afrika

Lesi sahluko sencwadi sifingqa ulwazi lwakamuva ngezifo ezifana ne-rinderpest, i-rabies, i-measles kanye ne-i-hiv (isandulela ngculaza), zonke ezibangelwa izilwanyana ezincane ezihlaselayo (amagciwane, amabhaktheriya nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezibhekwa njengezinhlobo ezingezona ezendawo, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile).
Lezi zifo zithinta zonke izilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqubuka kwazo kugcina kulimaza umnotho wezwe.

Emkhakheni wocwaningo obizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi yokuhlasela’, ososayensi bafunda izinto eziphilayo ezichuma futhi zenza umonakalo ngemva kokwethulwa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo oluningi lugxile kakhulu ezilwaneni ezinkulu "ezihlaselayo" ezifana nezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa izihlaseli ezincane ezibangela izifo zibalulekile ngokufanayo.
Kulesi sahluko, ababhali baxoxe ngezinye izifo zezilwane nezabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezibangelwa yilezo zinambuzane ezilethwe.
Bathi esiyingozi kakhulu kwakuyisifo se-'rinderpest', esatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
Umkhuhlane we-Rinderpest wawubangelwa yigciwane futhi wahlasela izinkomo nezinyathi.
Igciwane elifanayo libangele isifo somasisi kubantu.
Abantu abaningi basemakhaya babhekana nendlala ngemuva kokuqubuka kwesifo ngo-1896, kodwa lesi sifo manje sesiqediwe ngokugoma.
Ababhali bathi phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861, izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zazinamamarabi, nakuba abantu babengazi ukuthi lesi sifo siyini.
Ngo-1893, kwase kwaziwa ukuthi amarabi abangelwa yigciwane, ngakho-ke uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezithintekile nokugoma lezo ezingathintekile.
Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuqede lesi sifo futhi sisathinta izilwane zasendle eziningi ezifana nama-duiker, amabhubesi, izinja zasendle, izimpungushe kanye namaxoxo.
Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, izingane ezimbili zalunywa yi-Mongoose Ephuzi zashona ngenxa yamarabi.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, amarabi aba yinto evamile eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathi ngo-1954, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabo bathinteka ngamashoshozela.
Ngesikhathi lesi sahluko sasibhalwa, isifo somasisi sasibulala cishe izingane ezingu-400 nsuku zonke.
Bathi isifo somasisi sivamile lapho abantu nezinkomo bephila eduze.
Ababhali baphinde bakhuluma ngesifo esibizwa ngokuthi i-bovine tuberculosis (BTB), esibangelwa amagciwane.
I-BTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, izindlulamithi, izingulule, amabhubesi, amakudu, izinkawu kanye namabhubesi.
Bathe isifo se-BTB saqala ukubikwa epaki kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Uhulumeni walawula lesi sifo ngokubulala izinyathi ezazitheleleke.
Ababhali bathi elinye igciwane, elangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika ngabahambi abavela e-Europe, labangela isifo esibizwa ngokuthi ‘smallpox’ kubantu.
Lesi sifo sabulala ngaphezu kuka-90% wabantu bendawo baseKhoekhoe.
Ekupheleni kokuqubuka kwesifo, isiko lamaKhoekhoe lase libhujiswe cishe ngokuphelele.
Ababhali baphinde babika ngegciwane lokukhubazeka komzimba womuntu (i-HIV) elabangela ukuqubuka kwesifo se-AIDS.
Ososayensi basacabanga ukuthi igciwane laqala ukudluliselwa kubantu lisuka ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-zoonosis.
Igciwane laqala ukutholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Bathe, kusukela ngo-2019, i-HIV ibingakabi nomgomo noma umuthi wokwelapha.
Baphethe isahluko ngokukhuluma ngegciwane le-West Nile ne-African Swine Fever, abathi laqhamuka e-Afrika lasabalala eYurophu naseMelika.
I-West Nile virus yayidluliswa ngomiyane futhi yayibulala ikakhulukazi izinyoni, kodwa yayiphinde ithinte amahhashi nabantu.
Bathe izilwane ezifana nezinyamazane namagungumbane zidlulisa isifo somkhuhlane wezinkukhu zase-Afrika.
Lesi sifo sithinte izinkabi, futhi sathinta kakhulu amabhizinisi ezinkabi.
Ababhali bathi baxoxe kuphela ngezifo ezibangelwa amabhaktheriya namagciwane, ngakho-ke lesi sahluko asiyona incazelo ephelele yazo zonke izilwanyana ezincane ezihlaselayo.
Ababhali bebeqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika.
I-algorithm esekelwe ebufakazini yokuhlinzwa yokuphatha i-Odontogenic keratocyst
Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kusalokhu kuyisihloko esithokozisayo nesididayo ezincwadini zokuhlinzwa kwe-Oral and Maxillofacial.
Okwamanje, kunokuntuleka kwemvumelwano mayelana nokwelashwa okufanele kakhulu kweziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst.
Kuzo zonke izinketho zokwelashwa ezitholakalayo, akukho ndlela kuze kube manje ekhombise izinga lokuphindaphinda elinguziro noma eliseduze noziro ngaphandle kokusikwa okubanzi okunezindawo ezicacile.

Ngenxa yokuntuleka kobufakazi obusekelwe ezinhlelweni zokuhlinza zokuphatha iziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst emibhalweni, lolu cwaningo luhlose ukwethula uhlelo lokuhlinza, olusekelwe emiphumeleni yokuhlaziywa kwe-meta, olungase lube usizo ekuthuthukiseni ukwelashwa kweziguli ezinesimo lesi.

Sisebenzisa imingcele; usayizi, uhlobo lwezilonda (oluyinhloko noma olwesibili), isimo esihambisana nezimpawu noma esizimele se-lesion, ukuba khona kokuphazamiseka kwe-cortical, kanye nokuhlukaniswa; sethula isihlahla sokuthatha izinqumo, ukusiza ukuhlela ukwelashwa nokusiza ukufinyelela amathuba amancane kakhulu okubuyela emuva ekulawuleni i-odontogenic keratocyst.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa izindlela ezingcono zokwelapha isifo somhlathi.

Ngokuhlanganisa imiphumela evela ezifundweni ezikhona, abacwaningi bachaza izinyathelo ezicacile odokotela abangazilandela ukuze bakwazi ukuhlonza nokwelapha iziguli ezinesifo somhlathi esibizwa ngokuthi ‘odontogenic keratocyst’ (OKC).
I-OKC iyisilonda, noma ukukhula okungajwayelekile, emhlathini womuntu.
Odokotela bathola kunzima ukwelapha lesi simo, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthola enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa ngempumelelo.
Ngakho-ke, odokotela bafuna izindlela zokwelapha ngempumelelo nangokuhlala izilonda zomhlathi.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna izinyathelo ezibalulekile odokotela okufanele bazithathe ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe lesi sifo.
Bakwenza lokhu ngokusesha imibhalo ekhona, noma izindatshana zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Babefuna ulwazi oluthile mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC esikhathini esiyiminyaka engu-1, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ezingama-46 abazitholile.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-OKC yayivamile kakhulu kwabesilisa kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu kuze kube seminyakeni engu-90, nakuba yayivamile phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 nengu-30.
Lesi sifo sithinte kakhulu umhlathi ongezansi.
I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi emathanjeni, ukuvuvukala komhlathi kubonakala kuphela kamuva.
Iziguli ngokuvamile zazizwa ubuhlungu futhi zinezinto eziphuma (uketshezi, njengobovu, oluphuma esilondeni noma esilondweni), futhi izimpande zamazinyo azo zingase zishintshe indawo.
Bancome ukuthi odokotela basuse lonke igciwane namazinyo aseduze.

Uma isusiwe, kufanele basebenzise umuthi obizwa ngokuthi i-Carnoy’s solution, kanye ne-nitrogen ewuketshezi (uketshezi olubandayo olusetshenziselwa ukususa isikhumba esonakele ngokushesha) kanye ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-5FU, umuthi ojwayelekile womdlavuza).
Ngemva kwalokhu kwelashwa, abacwaningi batusa ukuthi isiguli sibe nokuhlolwa kwezempilo okuqhubekayo kuze kube iminyaka engama-25.
Bathe lokhu kwelashwa bekungcono kakhulu ezilondeni ezincane kunesithelo sesitrobheli (3 cm).
Ngama-izilonda amakhulu kuno-3 cm, abacwaningi baphakamise ukunakwa okwengeziwe.
Bathe odokotela kufanele kuqala behlise ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilonda bese besusa uketshezi, futhi basuse zonke izicubu ezizungeze umhlathi.
Ithambo kufanele bese liphathwa ngesixazululo sika-Carnoy.
Baphakamise ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlola lezi ziguli njalo ezinyangeni ezi-2 iminyaka emi-2.
Uma isiguli sinamasilonda amaningi, odokotela bangase bawakhiphe ngeminye imishini ekhethekile yesibhedlela.
Kodwa ngokujwayelekile, izifundo ezibuyekeziwe zikhombisile ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isilonda bese besebenzisa i-5FU, iziguli bezingeke ziphinde zithole i-OKC.
Nokho baxwayise ngokuthi ubufakazi bale mishanguzo abuhlali buqinile, futhi bathole izihloko zesayensi ezimbalwa ngalesi sihloko.
Abacwaningi abazange benze izivivinyo zabo ukuze bathole lezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazama ukuhlanganisa izinketho zokwelashwa ezaziwa kakhulu ezivela ezifundweni ezenziwa abanye abacwaningi.
Ngakho-ke laba bacwaningi, abazinze eNigeria nase-USA, baphakamise izifundo ezengeziwe emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuhlolwe impumelelo yokwelashwa okunconyiwe lapha.
Baphinde bakhuthaza odokotela ukuthi bacabangele ezinye izimo zesiguli ngesikhathi sokwelashwa.

Ukhuvethe ngokuvamile luhlobo oluthile lwezilwane njengomsingathi, izilwane ezincelisayo noma izinyoni kuye ngohlobo lwazo; nokho, lezi zigciwane ngezinye izikhathi zingashintsha umsingathi ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo.

I-HCoV-229E ingenye yezinhlobo eziyisithupha zokhuvethe lwabantu ezihlanganisa i-HCoV-NL63, i-HCoV-OC43, i-HCoV-HKU1, i-MERS-CoV kanye ne-SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 ne-SARS-CoV2) futhi isatshalaliswa emhlabeni wonke.
I-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV-2 zingahlala phezu kwezindawo ezingaphili ezifana nensimbi, ingilazi noma ipulasitiki kuze kufike ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalolunye (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Izinyathelo zokuvimbela kanye nokwelashwa ngemithi nge-hydrochloroquine kuyasiza, kodwa umgomo osebenza kahle ungadingeka ukuze kumiswe ukusabalala kwempathamhlaba i-covid-19.
Inhloso yocwaningo lwethu kwakuwukuhlonza ama-epitope angaba umgomo kusetshenziswa izindlela ze-bioinformatics.
Izinto Nezindlela

Ukulandelana kofuzo oluphelele lwe-SARS-CoV-2 kwatholakala ku-2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) nakwizizindalwazi ezimbili, okuhlanganisa i-National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Inﬂuenza Data (GISAID) kanye ne-TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver ye-bioinformatics eku-inthanethi.

Sizohlinzeka ngokubuyekezwa okufushane kwemvelaphi yegciwane, siqhathanise ulwazi lokulandelana ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezigcinwe, indawo yakhe evamile yephrotheni (isiza sokubopha okuqondiwe) kanye nedizayini ye-consensus motif yento engaba yikhandidethi (epitope) yokuphakanyiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha ze-2019-nCoV, SARSr-CoV strain kanye ne-MERS-CoV esanda kutholakala.
Okuthakazelisayo, ukuqhathaniswa kokulandelana phakathi kwe-SARS-CoV-2 nolunye uhlobo kwembule ukuthi izinsalela ezikhona kumgomo wokusebenzisana ne-receptor zigcinwe kakhulu nge-70% yokufana.
Saxhasa izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ezinhlanu (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor kusuka kumaphrotheni e-spike anesibopho sokuxhumana phakathi kwegciwane nomphathi.
Ku-SARS-CoV_ RBD kukhona izinsalela (D480, no-T487) ezivumele ukutheleleka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene.
Kodwa-ke, ku-SARS-CoV-2, ukuguqulwa okuncane kwezinye izinsalela kungathuthukisa ukuxhumana nomamukeli weselula yomuntu: L455, F486, Q493, kanye no-N501.
Ku-SARS-CoV, izinsalela ezimbili eziyinhloko (479 no-487) zihlotshaniswa nokuhlonzwa komamukeli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2, izinsalela ezihambisana ne-N479 zihambisana ne-Q493 kanye ne-T487 kuya ku-N501.
