Lolu cwaningo lunikeza ulwazi namathuba okuqinisekisa ngokwemvelo.
Lo msebenzi ungachazwa ngamagama e-bioinformatics, futhi ungaphindaphindwa kalula ngabanye, nakuba ulwazi olusha nocwaningo nge-COVID-19 kuvela futhi kuqhubeka ngokushesha okukhulu.
Ososayensi baqhathanisa i-COVID-19 namanye amagciwane ahlobene ukuze basize ukuthola imigomo.
NgoSepthemba 2020, ososayensi baseMali baqhathanisa ulwazi lofuzo oluvela egciwaneni le-Covid-19 namanye amakhaza amabili ahlobene kakhulu ukuze bathole izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukisweni komgomo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babesesafuna imigomo ephumelelayo ye-COVID-19.
Bebefuna ukukhomba ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo egciwaneni le-Covid-19 okungadlala indima ekutheleleni.
Ngakho-ke abacwaningi baseMali baqhathanisa igciwane le-Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) namanye amakhuvethe amabili adala izifo kubantu, okungukuthi i-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV.
Enye yezinhloso eziyinhloko zocwaningo kwakuwukuhlonza izindawo ezithile ku-virus ye-Covid-19, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-epitope, ezingabonwa amasosha omzimba womuntu.
Ukubona lezi kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi benze imigomo ephumelela kakhudlwana.
Abacwaningi baphinde baqhathanisa zonke izifo ezintathu ukuze babone ukuthi ngabe kukhona ukufana kofuzo okungasiza ngaphezulu ekuthuthukiseni umgomo.
Bagxile ekulandelaneni kofuzo kwamaphrotheni egciwane, okuyiwona amaphrotheni anesibopho sokusiza ukhuvethe ukunamathela nokutheleleka kumaseli womuntu.
Lokho abacwaningi abakutholile ukuthi amaphrotheni e-spike awo wonke amagciwane amathathu ayefana kakhulu ngokofuzo, ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezisebenzisana namaseli abantu.
Okugqamile ngegciwane le-Covid-19 ukuthi kwakukhona izinguquko ezincane ku-phrotheni ye-spike ezingenza igciwane lisebenze kahle ekubopheni kumaseli abantu.

Okutholakele kulolu cwaningo kungavumela abanye abacwaningi ukuthi bathuthukise imigomo ye-Covid-19 ephumelelayo ngokubasiza ukuthi bakhombe izindawo ezinhle kumgciwane ezilungele ukuba okuqondiwe kwemigomo.
Ucwaningo luphinde lunikeze ulwazi olusha mayelana nokufana nokwehluka kofuzo phakathi kwegciwane le-Covid-19 nezinye izinkhuvethe.

Abacwaningi baphawule ukuthi ucwaningo oluzayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni umehluko kofuzo egciwane le-Covid-19 ulwenza lube nomthelela omkhulu wokutheleleka futhi lube yingozi enkulu kunezinye izinkhuvethe.
I-Arrhythmia Yenhliziyo Kubaguli Abane-COVID-19: Ukubuyekezwa Okuhlelekile Nokuhlaziywa Kwe-Meta
I-arrhythmia yenhliziyo ayinakunganakwa ezigulini ezine-ukhuvethe 2019 (COVID-19) njengoba inethonya elikhulu emiphumeleni.
Ngakho-ke, lolu cwaningo beluhlose ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile mayelana nesigameko se-i-arrhythmia yenhliziyo ezigulini ezine-COVID-19.
Senze ukucinga okuhlelekile kumithombo yolwazi ethembekile/izinjini zokucinga ezihlanganisa i-PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library kanye ne-web of science.
Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, ulwazi olufanele lwathathwa futhi izigameko ezivela ezincwaningweni ezahlukene ezafakiwe zahlanganiswa ukuze kwenziwe i-meta-analysis.
Ekugcineni kufakwe izifundo eziyisishiyagalolunye ocwaningweni lwethu ezihlanganisa iziguli eziyi-1445.
Imiphumela yokuhlaziywa kwe-meta ikhombisile ukuthi isigameko se-arrhythmia ezigulini ezine-COVID-19 sasingu-19.7% nesikhathi sokuqiniseka (CI) esingu-95% esisukela ku-11.7 kuya ku-27.6%.
Kwakukhona futhi ingxubebunjalo ebalulekile (I2=94.67%).
I-arrhythmia yenhliziyo ibivame kakhulu ezigulini ezine-COVID-19 futhi ibonakale ku-19.7% yazo.
Ukuqapha okufanele nge-electrocardiogram ngokuhlonza kahle nangokushesha kwe-arrhythmias kubalulekile ekuphathweni okungcono kanye nemiphumela.
Iziguli eziningi ze-COVID-19 bezineshaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.
Abacwaningi bathi cishe 1 ku-5 weziguli ze-Covid-19 zibhekana ne-i-arrhythmia yenhliziyo, eyaziwa nangokuthi ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.

Njengoba kuvamile, batusa ukuqapha imijikelezo yenhliziyo yesiguli besebenzisa umshini obizwa nge-electrocardiogram, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukuthola nokwelapha noma yiziphi i-arrhythmias kusenesikhathi ngangokunokwenzeka.
Yize i-Covid-19 ithinta amaphaphu nohlelo lokuphefumula kakhulu, olunye ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi ingase ithinte nenhliziyo.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukubuyekeza ulwazi lweziguli ukuze babone ukuthi izinkinga zenhliziyo ezishaya ngokungajwayelekile zazivame kangakanani ezigulini ze-Covid-19 ngo-2020, ngasekuqaleni kwempathamhlaba yomhlaba wonke.

Basebenzise indlela yokuhlaziya ulwazi ethinta ukuhlaziywa kocwaningo oluningi oluhlukene ngesihloko esithile ukuze bazame ukuthola iziphetho ezijwayelekile ezivela kulo lonke ucwaningo oluhlanganisiwe.
Babheka izifundo ezibuyekezwe ontanga abanye abacwaningi kuma-database ajwayelekile, bakhipha noma yiluphi ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile ezigulini ze-Covid-19.
Ekugcineni, bafaka izifundo eziyi-9 ezinolwazi mayelana neziguli eziyi-1445.
Bathole ukuthi i-arrhythmia yenhliziyo ibonakale ku-19.7% yeziguli ezine-COVID-19.
Baxwayisa nokho ukuthi isibalo esincane sezifundo abazisebenzisile singase siphazamise isiphetho sabo.
Ezinye izifundo azizange zicacise uhlobo oluqondile lwenkinga yenhliziyo, futhi imikhawulo yaleyo naleyo cwaningo ingase idide imikhawulo yokuhlaziywa kwabo kwe-meta.
Baphakamisa ukuthi kubhekwe esikhathini esizayo ukuthi kungani iziguli eziningi ezine-Covid-19 zibe nezinga lenhliziyo elingajwayelekile.
Ababhali baleli phepha babevela eGibhithe, nokho iziguli kulolu cwaningo zazivela eChina nase-USA.
Imibono Yezinye Izazi Ngokufuduka, Impilo Yengqondo kanye Ne-PTSD:
Ukubuyekeza Kwezincwadi Ezifanele
Kulesi sahluko, sihlinzeka ngokubuyekezwa kwezincwaningo ezibhekiwe ezenziwa nge-PTSD, impilo yengqondo kanye nempilo enhle yabafuduki.
Izifundo eziningi ziphakamisa ukuthi kokubili ukucindezeleka kwangaphambi nangemva kokufuduka kuthinta impilo yengqondo kanye ne-PTSD yabafuduki nababaleki.
Emazweni abadabuka kuwo, ukuvezwa engozini kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kubeka izingozi ezinkulu empilweni yengqondo yabafuduki.

Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezibangela ukucindezeleka okukhulu kwabafuduki emazweni abawamukele zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka kwengqondo, isimo esingokomthetho, ukuhlukaniswa kwemindeni, isithiyo solimi, ukufinyelela okunganele ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okufanele, ukubandlululwa, ubuhlanga, imizwa yokungakwazi ukuzisiza, ukuzethemba okunciphile, ukucindezeleka kwama-hlalakhona kanye nokuhlala uqaphile.
Phakathi kwazo zonke izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukhwantalala, ukukhathazeka kanye ne-PTSD kubhekwa njengokujwayelekile kakhulu ngezibalo zokuvama ezingu-4-40%, 5-44% kanye no-9-36% ngokulandelana.
Ngokuvamile, ukwesekwa komphakathi kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nezimo zamandla okuhambisana nesimo kwatholakala njengokunciphisa ukuthinteka.
Impilo yengqondo yombaleki ithinteka yisimo esishiywe ngemuva kanye nokuhlala endaweni entsha.
Abafuduki nababaleki ababalekela emazweni angaphandle bavame ukubhekana nengcindezi eqhubekayo ye-post-traumatic kanye nezinye izinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenkathi izinkinga eziningi zidalwa yizinto ezenzeka emazweni abo asekhaya, ososayensi bathi kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi ingcindezi yokuhlala ezweni elisha ingangeza enkingeni.
Ngokwezifundo ezihlukahlukene, ukhwantalala, ukukhathazeka, kanye ne-post-traumatic stress disorder (i-PTSD) kuyizinkinga ezivamile zempilo yengqondo phakathi kwabafuduki nababaleki.
I-PTSD imvamisa iwumphumela wokuphila ezimweni eziyingozi noma ezilimazayo, futhi abantu bavame ukubhekana nemiphumela yalezo zehlakalo ezimbi izinyanga, noma ngisho neminyaka.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda izici ezahlukene ezidlala indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo yabafuduki ezifana ne-PTSD.
Ngakho-ke benza uhlobo locwaningo olubizwa ngokuthi isibuyekezo, lapho bafingqa khona ulwazi oluvela kwezinye izifundo eziningi ngesihloko, ukuze bathole izitayela noma izindikimba ezivamile.

Ezimweni eziningi, izinkinga zengqondo zabafuduki zaziyisiphumo sezehlakalo ezibuhlungu ezifana nempi, ukulahlekelwa yilabo abathandekayo, noma ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba okwenzeka emazweni abo asekhaya.
Ngesikhathi laba bantu beshiya lezo zimo, babhekana nohambo olunzima kodwa baphinde bazizwa bekhululekile lapho befika ezweni elisha.
Nokho, abacwaningi bathe lokhu kukhululeka kuvame ukuba kwesikhashana, ngoba abafuduki babhekana nezinselelo ezintsha ngemva kokuthuthela kwenye indawo.
Bathole ukuthi abafuduki bavame ukuba nobunzima ezweni elisha futhi, ikakhulukazi uma bengayiqondi ulimi, noma benzima ukujwayela isiko.
Lapho abantu befike ezweni ngokungemthetho, noma bezama ukuthola indawo yokukhosela, baphinde babhekane nezinkinga zomthetho, futhi kaningi babenobunzima bokuthola izinsiza ezifana nosizo lwezempilo.
Kwabanye, ubuhlanga nokucwasa ezweni labo elisha kwengeza emizweni yabo yokungaphephile, futhi abaningi babeshiyile amalungu omndeni emuva futhi babeyedwa.
Lezi zici zibe nomthelela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo eziqhubekayo, ngisho noma laba bafuduki sebebesesimweni esiphephile kunaleso esikhona ezweni labo.

Abacwaningi bangezelela ukuthi abafuduki babe namasu ahlukahlukene okubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kusukela ekuhleleni ngokucophelela ukuthi bangazilungisa kanjani, kuya ekufuneni usizo kwabanye emphakathini wabo, noma izindlela ezingezinhle ezifana nokusebenzisa izidakamizwa.
Abacwaningi bathi ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka kuzo zonke izigaba zohambo lomfuduki.
Ngokukhethekile, kubalulekile ukuphenya izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo emazweni abantu abadabuka kuwo, kodwa futhi nangesikhathi eside emazweni abo amasha.
Banezela ukuthi izinkambo zabantu abahamba bephuma e-Afrika beya eYurophu zidinga ukunakwa okwengeziwe okuvela kubacwaningi.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi abaseNingizimu Afrika nabaseJalimane, futhi luyingxenye yencwadi ekhuluma ngolwazi lwabafuduki base-Afrika abahlala emazweni aseYurophu.
Ukuba khona nokuhlala kwe-Amblyomma Hebraeum kwandisa umthwalo we-Heartwater eSifundeni SaseNingizimu seBotswana
I-Heartwater yisifo esitholakala emakhizaneni, esihlobene namagciwane egazi esinethuba lokunciphisa ukukhula kwamabhizinisi ezolimo eBotswana.
Lesi songo ekutholakaleni kokudla ezweni sibangelwa ukukhiqizwa okuphansi nokufa kwemfuyo ekufuyweni kokuziphilisa kwemfuyo emincane kunasemafamuni ezentengiso.
Lolu cwaningo lunikeza umbono ngomthwalo we-epidemiological we-heartwater eBotswana.
Amakhizane adla izilwane ezifuywayo ezigcinwe ezindaweni ezine ezingaphansi kweBotswana atholakala ngokuhlaziywa kwesimo somzimba kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo.
Abalimi baxoxwa ngakho ukuphathwa komthwalo we-heartwater ngaphakathi kwezigodi zabo ezihlukene.
Izibalo zamacala ezokwelapha izilwane zaqoqwa ukuze kuhlolwe imvamisa yamacala kuzo zonke izifunda eziseningizimu yeBotswana.

Imiphumela yocwaningo iveze; ukusabalala okubanzi kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izifunda ezine ezicwaningwe, ukwanda konyaka kancane kancane kwecala le-heartwater esifundeni esincane saseMoshupa kanye nenkomba yokwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zezimbuzi zomdabu naphezu kwemizamo yokulawula izilwane ezincane ezilumanayo ngama-63% abalimi abaxoxiswene nabo.

I-Amblyomma hebraeum, isilwane esincane esilumanayo esiyinhloko se-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu Afrika sisakazeke kabanzi eSifundeni esiseNingizimu seBotswana futhi ngaleyo ndlela sibeka inselelo ekukhiqizeni imfuyo kulesi sifunda, futhi mhlawumbe nakwezinye izindawo ezweni lapho ikhizane lihlasele khona imfuyo.
Ngakho-ke kunesidingo sokuhlola kabusha izindlela zokulawula amakhizane ezikhona ngenhloso yokunciphisa umthwalo wesifo senhliziyo ikakhulukazi ezimvini nasezimbuzini.
Inani eliphezulu lamakhizane eningizimu yeBotswana libhebhethekisa isifo senhliziyo emfuyweni.
Lolu cwaningo lubika ngomthwalo omkhulu wamakhizane kanye nesifo senhliziyo emanzini eningizimu yeBotswana phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukwenza izinhlelo zokulawula isifo se-heartwater ngendlela engcono.
Amakhizane athile athwala ibhaktheriya ebizwa ngokuthi i-Ehrlichia ruminantium, ebangela isifo esaziwa ngokuthi i-heartwater ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini.
Leli bhaktheriya liyisikhunta, kusho ukuthi lidla kwezinye izidalwa eziphilayo ezifana nezilwane ezifuywayo, libalimaza.
Imfuyo ephathwa isifo se-heartwater ivamise ukuba nokushisa komzimba okuphezulu, ilahlekelwe isifiso sokudla, ibe nezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi ingase ife ekugcineni.
I-Heartwater ivamile kakhulu engxenyeni eseningizimu yeBotswana, futhi abalimi bakuleyo ndawo balahlekelwa yimfuyo yabo ngenxa yalesi sifo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenya ngomthwalo we-heartwater eningizimu yeBotswana.
Baqala ngokuqoqa, ukubala nokuhlonza amakhizana ezinkomeni, izimvu nezimbuzi ukuze baqhathanise inani lamakhizana athwala ipharasayithi le-heartwater namanye amakhizana.
Abacwaningi baphinde baxoxa nabanye abalimi mayelana nolwazi lwabo nge-heartwater, futhi baqoqa eminye imibiko ye-heartwater ehhovisi lezempilo yezilwane.
Abacwaningi bathi amakhizane ayingozi asakazeke kakhulu endaweni yokucwaninga, futhi inani lamacala esifo senhliziyo amanzi lenyuke unyaka nonyaka.
Baqoqe omatheka abangu-310 phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Bathole izinhlobo ezi-3 zamakhizane: ikhizane laseNingizimu Afrika elibizwa ngokuthi i-bont, ikhizane elinezinzwane ezibizwa ngokuthi i-bont-legged, kanye nekhizane lenja elinsundu.
Okuyinto evame kakhulu kwakuyikhizane laseNingizimu Afrika elibizwa ngokuthi i-bont (85%), futhi leli yikhona elithwala amagciwane abanga isifo senhliziyo samanzi.
Ezinye izinhlobo ezimbili zamakhizane abazitholile azifaki isandla esifweni senhliziyo, kodwa zihlotshaniswa nezinye izifo zezifuyo ezifana ne-'theileriosis', 'anaplasmosis' kanye ne-'babesiosis'.
Indawo eyacwaningwa abacwaningi yayihlanganisa iGoodhope, iKanye, iMoshupa, neJwaneng.
Amakhizane ayemaningi e-Goodhope, e-Kanye nase-Moshupa.
Lezi zindawo zazimanzi kakhulu, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
IJwaneng, eyayinenani elincane kakhulu lamakhizane, yayomile, inothuli futhi inezitshalo ezimbalwa.

Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi ezokwelapha izilwane aveze ukuthi kube nezigameko ezingu-42 ze-heartwater e-Goodhope, ezingu-38 e-Jwaneng, ezingu-75 e-Kanye, kanye nezingu-146 e-Moshupa, kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019.
Abacwaningi bathi isifo senhliziyo samanzi sithinta izimbuzi nezinkomo zendawo kakhulu kunezinhlobonhlobo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.
Bathe abalimi benza imizamo ethile yokulawula amakhizane.
Isibonelo, ama-63% wabalimi bacwilisa izilwane ezibulalazinambuzane (amakhemikhali asetshenziswa ukubulala izinambuzane ezifana namakhizane).
Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (30%) yabalimi basebenzisa amafutha ezilwaneni zabo ukulawula amakhizane, kanti abanye (7%) bakhetha ukwakha izibaya ezintsha.

Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi abangama-44% balimi abenzanga lutho ukubhekana nesilwane esisolwa ukuthi siyagula, kanti abangama-15% bathi bazovakashela izikhulu zezokwelapha izilwane ukuthola izeluleko, kodwa banikeza izilwane imithi ngokwabo.
Nakuba kwakukhona umgomo otholakalayo wokuvikela isifo se-heartwater, abacwaningi bathi u-93% wabalimi babengawusebenzisi.
Abalimi batshela abacwaningi ukuthi kwakungenxa yokuthi babengafundiswanga ngalo mgomo, futhi ngoba babengakwazi ukukhokhela umgomo.

Ezinye izifundo esikhathini esedlule zabheka ukuthi amakhizane asatshalaliswa kanjani e-Afrika, kuhlanganisa neBotswana, kodwa ngokusho kwabacwaningi, eyabo yayiyokuqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwamakhizane nezimo ze-heartwater eBotswana.

Bathi izigameko ze-heartwater ezibhalwe odokotela bezilwane kungenzeka ukuthi zincane kunalezo ezibhekene nabalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukwenza test ye-heartwater kuphela uma isilwane sesifile, okusho ukuthi izilwane eziphila nalesi sifo noma izilwane eziphilile azihlali zibaliwe.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuthi abalimi bafundiswe ukuthi bangayilawula kanjani futhi bayiphathe kanjani isifo se-heartwater emfuyweni yabo, ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo waso endaweni.
Baphinde bathi kufanele kwenziwe ucwaningo olunye ukuze kutholakale izici eziholela ekuchumeni kwamakhizane.
Abacwaningi bebezinze eBotswana.
Izithiyo ekuhlolweni kwe-Point of Care e-India naseNingizimu Afrika

Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC emiphakathini, ezindaweni zasekhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo kukholakala ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekunciphiseni ukubambezeleka ekuhlonzeni nasekuqaliseni ukwelashwa kwezifo ezifana ne-HIV, isifo sofuba, isifo sokuwa, kanye nomalaleveva.

Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha ezenziwe kuleso simo sezokwelapha noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngenkathi isiguli silindile, kuthembisa ukunqoba ukubambezeleka okuhlobene nokuhlolwa okujwayelekile okusekelwe elebhu.
Nokho, ukutholakala kwezinsizakuhlola ezishibhile, ezilula, nezisheshayo ezingasetshenziswa ngaphandle kwamalabhorethri akusho ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuyophumelela ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselelo amadivayisi ezokwelapha afana nalawa abhekana nazo, sidinga ukufunda ukuthi ukuhlolela isifo kusetshenziswa kanjani e-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe kanjani emsebenzini nasezindleleni zezokwelapha.
Lesi sahluko sibuyekeza imiphumela ekhethiwe evela kuphrojekthi yocwaningo lwekhwalithethivu mayelana nezithiyo zokuhlolwa kwe-POC e-India naseNingizimu Afrika futhi siyixoxa ngokuyiqhathanisa.

Iphrojekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingahleliwe kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu okugxilwe kuwo ukuhlola izindlela zokuhlola izifo ezinkulu kanye nabalingisi emakhaya, emitholampilo, emiphakathini, ezibhedlela, nasezindaweni zokuhlola eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Uma kuqhathaniswa imiphumela ekhethiwe, kuyacaca ukuthi womabili amazwe anezinhlelo ezihlukene kakhulu zokuhlola ezihlinzeka ngezimo ezihlukene kakhulu zokuhlolwa kwe-POC.
Isahluko siphetha ngokucabangela ukuthi ungawathatha kanjani la maqiniso uma uhlela izinhlelo zokuhlola ze-POC.
Ukuhlolwa okunganele ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kubambezela ukunakekelwa kwezempilo
I-Point-of-care (POC) ibhekisela ekuhlolweni kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isiguli sithola khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuba kuthunyelwe izampula zesiguli kude nelabhorethri ukuze kuhlolwe.
INingizimu Afrika neNdiya azihlinzeki ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokusebenzayo ngenxa yezinhlelo ze-POC nezindawo zokuhlola ezingezinhle.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuba zithole ukuhlolwa okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini eshibhile futhi elula enganikeza imiphumela yokuhlola ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthatha amasampula ayiswe emalabhorethri.
Kodwa kunezinselelo eziningi ku-POC ezithiya ukunakekelwa kweziguli eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ababhali bebefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya ukuze bakwazi ukuthola izinkinga.
Benza izingxoxo kanye nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zemishini yezokwelapha kusukela ngoSepthemba, 2012, kuya kuJuni, 2013, emazweni womabili.
Babuza ngezindlela zokusebenza ze-POC nezinkinga.

Ezinhlakeni zomphakathi zezempilo, iNdiya isebenzisa amalabhorethri amancane amaningi futhi yenza izivivinyo eziyisisekelo, kodwa amalabhorethri awo awanikezwa imali eyanele, ngakho awanazo izinto ezanele zokwenza ukuhlola.
Iziguli zivame ukutshelwa ukuthi zibuye ngelinye ilanga noma ziye kwenye indawo, okudala izinkinga ezizigulini.

Abacwaningi baphinde baqaphela ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi iziguli ziyahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi imiphumela ibuyele, futhi zithola kunzima ukuxhumana nodokotela wazo ngemuva kwalokho.
Ababambiqhaza bathi kufanele kube namalabhorethri amaningi ezibhedlela, futhi ukuhlolwa kungaqhutshwa endaweni efanayo lapho iziguli zingena khona.
Baphinde bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi kwezempilo yomphakathi, inkampani eyodwa iphethe wonke ama-test, ngakho-ke ama-isampula aya kule nkampani.
Ezinye izivivinyo eziyisisekelo zenziwa endaweni yokunakekelwa, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ne-TB kuthatha isikhathi eside ngakho-ke ukulandela noma ukwelashwa nakho kubambezelekile.
Okunye ukubambezeleka kubangelwa izinkinga zezokuthutha, ukupelwa okungalungile kwamagama eziguli, ukuphawulwa okungalungile kwezinsampula, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwamasisitimu ekhompyutha.
Ekutholeni i-HIV, amanye amalebhu asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engathembekile.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli zizama ukuthola ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ngokusekelwe ebangeni eliya endaweni noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokhu kwesinye isikhathi zisebenzisa ikhadi likamazisi elihlukile, okudala izinkinga uma kuzanywa ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze babelane ngomthwalo womsebenzi.
Bathi uma kufika amakhithi amasha okuhlola i-HIV, abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi izinhlelo kufanele zibuyekezwe.
Ababhali baqhathanise ulwazi lwe-POC kusuka kuwo womabili amazwe futhi baphakamise ukuthi iziphathimandla kumele zibheke kahle i-POC ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo noma amadivayisi amasha.
Baphinde bathi kudingeka umzamo owengeziwe ekubhekaneni nemithwalo yomsebenzi emalabhorethri nasekuqondeni indima edlalwa isiguli ekunakekelweni kwaso kwezempilo.
Ababhali baleli phepha bebevela eNingizimu Afrika, eNdiya, eKhanada naseNetherlands.
Ngokubheka izincazelo zokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziywa kwemibono

Njengoba "ukugula okubucayi" kanye "nokunakekelwa okubucayi" kungekho izincazelo ezivumelanisiwe, lolu cwaningo luhlose ukuhlola ukuthi le misho isetshenziswa kanjani, ichaze izici ezichazayo futhi iphakamise izincazelo ezingaba khona.
Sisebenzise indlela yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo ka-Walker no-Avant yokuhlaziya umqondo.
Ukusetshenziswa nezincazelo zemibono kwatholakala ngokubuyekezwa kwesikophu sokubhala kanye nenhlolovo ye-inthanethi yochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangu-114 emhlabeni wonke.
Ngokuhlaziya okuqukethwe kolwazi sathola amakhodi, izigaba nezindikimba ukuze sinqume izimfanelo ezichazayo zemibono futhi saphakamisa izincazelo ezingaba khona.
Ukuze sisize ukuqonda, sethula imodeli, amacala ahlobene futhi aphikisanayo mayelana nemibono, sakhomba izandulela nemiphumela yemibono, futhi sachaza izinkomba ezibonakalayo.
Izici ezichazayo zokugula okubucayi kwakuyingozi enkulu yokufa okuseduze; ukuphazamiseka kwezitho ezibalulekile; isidingo sokunakekelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukufa; kanye nokubuyiselwa emuva okungenzeka.

Izici ezichazayo zokunakekelwa okubucayi kwakuwukukhomba, ukuqapha nokwelapha ukugula okubucayi; ukusekelwa kwezitho ezibalulekile; ukunakekelwa kokuqala nokuhlala njalo; noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kokugula okubucayi; kanye nezinsiza ezikhethekile zabantu nezomzimba.

Incazelo yethu ephakanyisiwe yokugula okubucayi ithi, "isimo sokugula esinokungasebenzi kahle kwezitho ezibalulekile zomzimba, ingozi enkulu yokufa okuseduze uma ukunakekelwa kunganikezwa kanye namathuba okuphindaphinda."

Incazelo yethu ephakanyisiwe yokunakekelwa okubucayi ithi, "ukukhomba, ukuqapha nokwelapha iziguli ezinesimo esibi ngokusebenzisa ukusekelwa kokuqala nokuhlala njalo kwemisebenzi yezitho ezibalulekile zomzimba."
Imiqondo yokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi ayinazo izincazelo ezivumelana futhi inezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokusetshenziswa.

Ngokuhlaziya imiqondo yokusetshenziswa nezincazelo ezincwadini nakubachwepheshe sihlonze izici ezichazayo zemiqondo futhi siphakamisa izincazelo ezingasiza ekusebenzeni kwezokwelapha, ucwaningo, kanye nokwenza inqubomgomo.
Amandla Nezingqinamba Zocwaningo
Lolu hlaziyo lomqondo lungolokuqala ucwaningo oluchaza ngendlela ehlelekile ukusetshenziswa nezincazelo zemibono yokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi.

Ucwaningo lusebenzisa ukubuyekezwa kwesikophu sezincwadi kanye neminikelo evela kochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangaphezu kwekhulu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni jikelele ukuze kutholakale izici ezichazayo futhi kunikezwe izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe zemibono.
Ezinye izindlela nezincazelo zemibono ngezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi, ezincwadini ezingashicilelwe nezivela kochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangafakiwe ocwaningweni kungenzeka ukuthi zaphuthelwa.
Njengoba ukusetshenziswa okwamanje kwemibono kuhlukahlukene, izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe kungenzeka zingamukelwa umhlaba wonke futhi zihloselwe ukuvuselela ingxoxo eyengeziwe.
Abacwaningi baphinde bachaza kabusha ukuthi kusho ukuthini "iziguli ezigula kakhulu" kanye nokunakekelwa kwazo.
Izincazelo ezijwayelekile zokunakekelwa kweziguli ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke yibo bonke odokotela zingasiza ekunakekeleni iziguli ezigula kakhulu.
Kulesi sifundo, ithimba labacwaningi bamazwe ngamazwe liphakamisa ukuthi "ukugula okubucayi" kusho ukuthi nakuba isiguli esigulayo sinamathuba aphezulu okufa, singase siphinde sisinde.
Baphinde bathi "ukunakekelwa" okunikezwa iziguli ezigula kakhulu kufanele kusho noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa okunikezwa kusukela ngesikhathi zifika esibhedlela, kuze kube zifa noma zisindile.
Akufanele futhi kubhekisele kuphela ekunakekelweni kusetshenziswa imishini ekhethekile.
Ezibhedlela, odokotela bavame ukubiza iziguli ezigula kakhulu ngokuthi "zigula kakhulu", futhi ukunakekelwa nokusekelwa okudingwa yilezi ziguli kubizwa ngokuthi "ukunakekelwa okubucayi".
Kodwa-ke, odokotela abasebenza ezindaweni noma ezibhedlela ezahlukene baqonda la magama ngendlela ehlukile, ngoba izincazelo zabo ziyahlukahluka ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye.
Lokhu kuholela ekutheni, isibonelo, iziguli ezinesimo esifanayo zithole ukwelashwa noma ukunakekelwa okuhlukile, kuye ngokuthi ngubani ozisizayo.
Izinchazelo ezihlukene nazo zenza kube nzima kubahulumeni ukwazi inani langempela lezifo ezisesimweni esibi ezweni labo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baqale bahlaziya ukuthi odokotela abahlukene bachaza kanjani "ukugula okukhulu" kanye "nokunakekelwa okukhulu", bese bephakamisa izincazelo ezihleleke kakhudlwana.
Baqukatha ulwazi ngokubuyekeza ezinye izindatshana ezashicilelwa.
Baphinde baxoxisane nodokotela abavela emazweni ahlukahlukene emhlabeni ababenolwazi lokwelapha iziguli ezigula kakhulu.

Abaphenyi babhala izincazelo ezahlukene zokugula okubucayi, futhi baphawula ukuthi ngokuvamile kwakuhlotshaniswa nethuba eliphezulu lokuthi iziguli zife; ezinye izingxenye zomzimba zingasebenzi; isidingo sokunakekelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukufa; kanye namathuba okuphola.
Ngodaba lokufa nokusinda, ezinye izincazelo zakhombisa ukuthi zonke iziguli ezigula kakhulu zizogcina zishonile, kanti ezinye zakhombisa ithuba lokuthi isiguli singasinda naphezu kokuba sisimo esibi.

Ekugcineni, abaphenyi baphakamise ukuchaza ukugula okubucayi njengokugula lapho izitho zomzimba ziyeka ukusebenza, lapho kunethuba eliphezulu lokuthi isiguli singafa uma singanakekelwa kahle, kodwa kunethuba lokululama.

Ngokunakekelwa okukhulu, odokotela babonakala bekuchaza ngendlela efanayo kakhulu, kodwa bahlukana mayelana nokuthi ukunakekelwa okunjalo kufanele kunikezwe kuphi, kanye nesidingo semishini ekhethekile.
Ezinye izinsiza zathi ukunakekelwa kwesimo esibi kungahlinzekwa kuphela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhethekile esibhedlela ngemishini ekhethekile.
Abanye babecabanga ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwesimo esibi kungase kuhlanganise ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, kodwa kwakungeyona imfuneko.
Bathi ukunakekelwa kwesimo esibi kungahlinzekwa ngisho nasezindaweni ezijwayelekile, ezikhungweni ezincane zezempilo, emphakathini noma ezimotweni eziphuthumayo.
Bathi ngisho nasezindaweni ezihlwempu, iziguli ezigula kakhulu zidinga ukunakekelwa kwesimo esibi.

Ngakho-ke abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubucayi kungachazwa njengakho konke ukunakekelwa iziguli ezinesimo esibi ezikutholayo kusukela ngesikhathi zivakashela abasebenzi bezempilo ukuze zithintane kuze kube yisikhathi zishona noma ziphila.
Abacwaningi bathe lolu bekulucwaningo lokuqala oluqoqe ulwazi ngencazelo ehlukene yokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa, futhi imiphumela yabo izosiza ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abagula kakhulu.
Nokho bathi ucwaningo lwabo lungaba nemikhawulo ngenxa yokuthi abazange basebenzise izincazelo ezivela kwezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi noma ezivela emithonjeni engashicilelwe.
Baphinde baxoxisana nodokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziywa kwabo akumele wonke amazwe emhlabeni.
Abacwaningi, ababevela emanyuvesi aseMalawi, eTanzania, eSweden nase-UK, bathe izincazelo zabo eziphakanyisiwe zingashintshwa uma kudingeka.
Isikrini se-CRISPR-Cas9 esibanzi ku-ufuzo jikelele sithola i-CENPJ njengomlawuli womsingathi wokuguqulwa kokuhlelwa kwemithambo emincane ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kwePlasmodium esibindini.

Ngaphambi kokuba kuqale umalaleveva onemiphumela, i-Plasmodium sporozoite eyodwa ithelelela i-hepatocyte bese ithuthuka ibe izinkulungwane zama-merozoites, ngokwengxenye ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zomsingathi.
Sikhombisa ukuthi imisila emincane yomsingathi ihlelwa kabusha ngokushintshashintsha ezungeze isidlagazi esikhulayo sesigaba sezinso (LS).

Sisebenzisa isikrini se-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9, sithole abalawuli bomsingathi bokuhlelwa kwesakhiwo se-cytoskeleton, ukuhamba kwe-vesicle, ukucindezeleka kwe-ER/Golgi kanye nokwakheka kwamafutha abalawula ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Plasmodium LS.
Laba balawuli abasha bokutheleleka, okubandakanya i-Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), basiholele ekubuzeni ukuthi izikhungo ezihlela ama-microtubule (MTOCs) zilawulwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
Amafoci e-γ-tubulin atholakala emaphethelweni esidlagazi; ukuncipha kwe-CENPJ kwandisa lokhu kutholakala kabusha futhi kwandisa ukutheleleka.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhombisa ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-MTOC engeyona i-centrosomal ngokuhlela i-γ-tubulin nokukhuthaza i-microtubule nucleation emaphethelweni esidlagazi.

Ngokuhlanganyela, sikhombisa ukuthi i-Plasmodium LS iqasha i-Golgi yomsingathi ukuze kwakhiwe izindlela eziphakathi nendawo eziholwa yi-MT lapho izitho zomzimba zomsingathi ziqashwa ku-PVM, ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba sezinso.
Okutholakele kwethu kuphakamisa ukuthi izinqamuleli eziningi zokwelapha ezihloswe umsingathi zingavimbela ukutheleleka kwe-LS.
Ososayensi bacwaninga ukuthi umalaleveva ungenelela kanjani kumaseli ukuze bazame ukwandisa izinketho zokwelashwa.
Izincelakazi eziningi zisebenzisa izakhamzimba nezinsiza zamangqamuzana omsingathi wazo womuntu noma wesilwane ukuze ziziphindaphinde.

Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bakhombe izakhi zofuzo ezithile ezidlala indima ekutheni umalaleveva ungene ezicutshini zesibindi, okungaholela ekutheni kutholakale izidakamizwa ezintsha ezilwa nomalaleveva ezizayo.
Umalaleveva yisifo esisabalele futhi esingaba yingozi empilweni esibangelwa i-Plasmodium parasite, esisakazwa ngokulunywa omiyane.

Uma lingena emzimbeni, i-Plasmodium iya ngqo esibindini ukuze izale - lesi sigaba sokuqala sifaneleke kakhulu ekwelashweni kwe-anti-umalaleveva ngoba azikho izimpawu zesifo okwamanje futhi lesi sifo asikwazi ukudluliselwa.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuthola izinguquko ezithile zofuzo namaprotheni kumasosha omzimba wesibindi athelelekile angashintsha ukuthi ukutheleleka kuthuthuka kanjani.

Basebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuhlela ufuzo i-CRISPR-Cas9, abacwaningi bakwazi ukuvala noma “ukukhupha” izakhi zofuzo ezithile ukuze babone ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko ezenzekayo lapho lezo zakhi zofuzo zingasebenzi.
Babe sebethelela kokubili amasosha omzimba esibindi ajwayelekile kanye nalawo "akhishiwe" ngezimuncagazi zomalaleveva.
Lezi zakhiwo ezifana namapayipi zibandakanyeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ekunyakazeni kwezakhamzimba nezinto ngaphakathi kwamaseli, futhi zivame ukwakha inethiwekhi ezungeze isizinda senkombafuzo.

Omunye wemiphumela ebalulekile ukuthi i-Plasmodium ithumba ama-microtubules kumaseli esibindi - esikhundleni sokuthi ama-microtubules ahlangane azungeze isizinda senkombafuzo aletha izakhamzimba nezinto lapho iseli izidinga khona, ama-microtubules ahlangane azungeze isidlagazi aletha izakhamzimba nezinto ukusiza isidlagazi sizale.

Abacwaningi babona ukuthi lapho beqeda iphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-CENPJ, isidlagazi saba nempumelelo enkulu ekuqoqeni ama-microtubules azungeze sona, futhi izidlagazi zakhula zaba nkulu futhi zenza amakhophi amaningi azo.
Ososayensi baphinde bathola ezinye izakhi zofuzo eziningana ezinomthelela ekutheni isifo sokutheleleka ngeplasmodium sibe sibi kangakanani.
Abacwaningi baveze phambilini ukuthi ezinye izidlagazi zihlela kabusha ama-microtubules ukuze ziqondise kabusha izinsiza ngaphakathi kweseli kuzoqobo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baqinisekisa ukuthi izidlagazi ze-Plasmodium zingasebenzisa leli qhinga ukuhambisa kabusha izakhamzimba nezinye izinsiza ukuze zithuthukise zona.

Esikhathini esizayo, ososayensi bathemba ukusebenzisa ukuqonda kwabo kokuthi ufuzo nezidlagazi zisebenzisana kanjani ngaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ukuze bathole izindlela ezintsha zokwelapha umalaleveva.

Yize abacwaningi bethole izinguquko ezithakazelisayo kumaprotheni amaseli esibindi ezigabeni zokuqala zomalaleveva, kusekuningi okudingeka kwenziwe ukuze kuqondwe kahle ukuthi i-Plasmodium iguqula kanjani amakhemikhali namsebenzi wamaseli ukuze okuqondiwe okuthile kwemithi kungaqashelwa.
Izinkulungwane eziningi zokufa zisenzeka minyaka yonke ngenxa ye-umalaleveva, inani elikhulu lazo lise-Afrika.

NgokweNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba, ngaphezu kuka-90% wezigameko zikamalaleveva emhlabeni ngo-2019 zenzeka e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube udaba olubalulekile oludinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulawula nokungenelela.
Ukuhlasela Kwe-Biological Njengengxenye Yomzamo Wocwaningo Lokushintsha Kwezwe LaseNingizimu Afrika
Kulesi sahluko, sihlola ukuthi ucwaningo olungakanani eNingizimu Afrika olubhekiswe ekulweni nama-biological invasion uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izici zoshintsho lomhlaba.

Sisebenzisa i-Web of Science, sabuyekeza ngokuhleleka izincwadi ezihlobene nezemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezashicilelwa phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 futhi eziphathelene nokuhlasela kwe-biological, inguquko yobunjalozwe, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, ukuguquka kwehabitat, ukungcola, kanye/noma i-CO2 emkhathini.

Sihlonze amaphepha angu-1149 afanele abekwe umphumela ngokwezinga lokuhlanganiswa kwawo kwabashayeli kanye nokusebenzisana kwabashayeli okuthinta ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem.
Umphumela oqinile we-spatio-temporal wabonwa emzamweni wocwaningo.

Okokuqala, umzamo wawuhlukile phakathi kwezindawo, lapho ukuguquka kwemvelo, ukungcoliswa kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile kuthola ukugxila okukhulu kocwaningo ezindaweni zomhlaba, zamanzi ahlanzekile kanye nezilwandle/izindawo ezinechibi ngokulandelana.
Okwesibili, ezinye izenzakalo ezaziwa kahle emhlabeni jikelele azibhalwanga emibhalweni yasendaweni (isb. bekukhona amaphepha angaphansi kwayisihlanu mayelana nokuncipha kwe-asidi olwandle).

Sihlonze ukusebenzisana okuhlukene okungu-21 phakathi kwabashayeli, lapho ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kanye noshintsho lwendawo (isibonelo izinguquko ezikhundleni zomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselwe) kuyizinto ezivelele kakhulu.
Nokho, ngaphansi kuka-4% wamaphepha abhekane nokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.

Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi nakuba ukubaluleka kokuqonda ukusebenzisana kwabashayeli kuyaziwa, kube kuncane kakhulu ucwaningo olwenziwe mayelana nemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzisana kwabashayeli ezemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Isitatimende esidala esithi izilwane ezihlaselayo zibeka usongo lwesibili olukhulu ekugcinweni kwemvelo, ngemuva kokushintsha kwehabitat, sihambisana nomphumela wocwaningo oluhlobene nalomshayeli eNingizimu Afrika.

Ukuthuthukisa isithombe esiphelele esilinganiselwe sokubaluleka okuhlobene kwabashayeli bezinguquko zomhlaba kuzoba yinselelo, hhayi kuphela ekuchazeni ngokusobala abashayeli, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokungalingani kokutholakala kwemiphumela yocwaningo ezingeni elilinganayo ngokwendawo nangokwesikhathi.
Ubukhulu bokuvuthwa komsebenzi wezilwane ezihlaselayo bungahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlola ukusebenzisana okuyinkimbinkimbi okunjalo futhi ngaleyo ndlela kube negalelo ekunqobeni izithiyo ezinjalo.
Abacwaningi kumele babhale imephu yemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yezilwane ezihlaselayo, inguquko yobunjalozwe kanye nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika
Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ziyingozi yesibili enkulu ekongeni ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elihambisana, kusho abacwaningi, nenani lamaphepha ocwaningo enziwe ngalesi sihloko.
Lokhu kuhlobene nezinye izinsongo ezifana nokungcoliswa kwemvelo, inguquko yobunjalozwe, ukuvunwa ngokweqile noma izinguquko endaweni yokuhlala.

Lezi zinsongo kuma-ecosystem yizo ososayensi abaziqamba ngokuthi izishayeli zokushintsha komhlaba, okuyisifundo sokuthi umhlaba, njengohlelo, ushintsha kanjani nazo zonke izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu nezinye izinqubo zomzimba, zamakhemikhali nezemvelo.

Esahlukweni sencwadi esisanda kushicilelwa, abacwaningi babheke ukuthi ngempela kwenziwa malini ucwaningo eNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuhlaselwa kwebhayoloji, okuyilapho izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo noma izilwane zethulwa endaweni entsha lapho zikhula khona, zisunguleka futhi zingase zibe yingozi kwezinye izinhlobo ezizungezile noma imvelo.
Baphinde babheka ucwaningo lokuthi lo mshoshaphansi uxhumana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.
Bheka emaphepheni ocwaningo ashicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 ku-database ye-"Web of Science", bathola izifundo eziyi-1149 ezifanelekile.

Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kocwaningo kwabonisa ukuthi ucwaningo olusekelwe emhlabeni (olusemhlabeni) lugxile kakhulu ekuguqukeni kwehabitat, kanti ucwaningo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lugxile ekungcolisweni, futhi ucwaningo lolwandle kanye nezindawo zokuhlangana kwamanzi lwalugxile kakhulu ekudobeni ngokweqile.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi izenzakalo ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni jikelele ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle ezifundweni zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Isibonelo, bathole amaphepha ama-5 kuphela abheka i-acidification yolwandle, ephazamisa izixhumanisi zokudla futhi ilimaza impilo yasolwandle.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-carbon dioxide eyengeziwe emkhathini, evela ezenzweni zabantu ezifana nokushisa izibaso ezimbiwa phansi, iyancibilika emanzini olwandle.
Izinguquko zendawo yokuhlala, njengemililo noma izinguquko zobunjalozwe, ziholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Bathi i-carbon dioxide inyuke cishe ngo-40%, futhi ingase idale izimo ezingcono zokuthi izitshalo zangaphandle zikhule.
Kodwa, kunocwaningo oluncane kakhulu olwenziwe ngalesi sihloko eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathole amaphepha angama-21 abheka ukuthi abashayeli abahlukene baxhumana kanjani.
Iningi lalokhu ligxile ekuxhumaniseni izinguquko zemvelo nezilwane ezihlaselayo.
Kodwa, amaphepha ambalwa kakhulu abheka abashayeli abangu-3 noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Ababhali bathi lokhu kuphakamisa ukuthi kudingeka olunye ucwaningo oluthe xaxa mayelana nendlela izimbangela zokuguquka komhlaba ezisebenzisana ngayo ukuthinta ezemvelo eNingizimu Afrika.

Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika bayavuma ukuthi kuzoba nzima ukuthuthukisa isithombe esiphelele sokuthi izishayeli zoshintsho lomhlaba jikelele zisebenzisana kanjani eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa bathi ucwaningo lwendawo olukhona ngezinhlobo ezihlaselayo lungase lube usizo ezifundweni kule ndawo eyinkimbinkimbi.
Izici zenhlabathi ezilawula izinto eziphilayo zenhlabathi kanye nokugcinwa kwe-C emahlathini e-miombo, eZambia
Inhlabathi enezinto eziphilayo (SOM) iyingxenye ebalulekile ekukhiqizeni kwamahlathi kanye nesitoko se-carbon enhlabathini.
Nokho, kuncane okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhluka kwe-SOM ne-C ezihlahleni ze-miombo okuyisistimu ebalulekile emahlathini ase-sub-Sahara Afrika futhi ebalulekile kumasu e-REDD+.

Kulesi sifundo, izici eziyisishiyagalolunye zenhlabathi zalinganiswa futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukwehluka kwe-SOM ezindaweni zehlathi lemiombo ezinezakhiwo ezihlukene zezihlahla eLuanshya, eZambia.
Okutholakele kukhombise ukwehluka okukhulu kwezinqolobane ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukahlukene kwenhlabathi:
36.67 kuya ku-113.89 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-0-10 cm, 28.67 kuya ku-79.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-10-20 cm, kanye no-31.89 kuya ku-98.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-20-30 cm.

Lezi zibaluli ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukahlukene nazo zahluka phakathi kwezindawo zehlathi le-miombo ezineziteji ezihlukene zokulandelana, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezithintekile ngokususwa kwezihlahla zakamuva zazine-SOM ephezulu kunokujwayelekile ngokwesendlalelo ngasinye (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).

Ukuhlaziywa kokuhambisana okuyisisekelo (i-CCA) kwembule ukuthi izici zemvelo ezibaluleke kakhulu ezithinta i-SOM kwakuwukuncipha kwehlathi ngokuhlanza, kanye nokuqukethwe kwesiliti ngaphakathi kwezinhlabathi.

Lolu cwaningo lugqamisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukukhombisa ukubaluleka okuhlobene kweziteji ezahlukene zokulandelana kwamahlathi njengomsebenzi wezindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezici zenhlabathi, ekutholeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM yenhlabathi ye-miombo.

Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ibaluleke kakhulu ekubhekaneni nezinhlelo zamanje ze-REDD+ zokubuyisela amahlathi nokuphatha ezihlose ukukhulisa izinqolobane zekhabhoni emahlathini afudumele asezansi nesahara e-Afrika.
Sika izihlahla ngokucophelela ukuthuthukisa inhlabathi, kusho ososayensi abacwaninga amahlathi aseZambia.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo zehlathi ezihlanzekile kanye nezingqimba eziphezulu zenhlabathi ehlathini eZambia zazinezinto eziphilayo eziningi, okusho ukuthi inhlabathi eneqophelo elingcono.
Kubalulekile ukuqonda izinga lenhlabathi e-zansi nesahara Afrika njengoba linomthelela omkhulu ekutheni izitshalo nezihlahla zikwazi kanjani ukuphumelela.
Inhlabathi inezakhamzimba ezahlukene, kanti izinto eziphilayo nekhabhoni yizona ezibaluleke kakhulu ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle.
Izinto eziphilayo ziyizinhlanganisela emhlabathini ezivela ezinsaleleni zezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Ngaphezu kwengxenye (58%) yendaba ephilayo iyikhabhoni kuphela, kanti okusele kungamanzi nezinye izakhamzimba.
Inhlabathi enenqwaba yezinto eziphilayo, futhi i-carbon ngakho-ke, igcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi inezinye izakhamzimba eziningi.
Ososayensi abazi kakhulu mayelana nezinguquko ezintweni eziphilayo namakhabhoni enhlabathini yasezansi nesahara e-Afrika, nakuba zibaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni kwezitshalo nezihlahla.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuthola ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zenhlabathi ehlathini zishintsha kanjani, nokuthi yini enquma amanani.
Benze ucwaningo lwabo ehlathini eZambia.
Baqoqa amasampula enhlabathi phezulu (0-10 cm), maphakathi (10-20 cm), nasekujulenii (-julile) (20-30 cm), nasezindaweni ezahlukene zehlathi.
Abacwaningi babe sebetesta inhlabathi elebhu ukuze bahlolisise ukuthi inani elingakanani lezinto eziphilayo eliqukethe.
Ilabhorethri iyisakhiwo lapho ososayensi benza khona izivivinyo nokuhlola, ngokuvamile besebenzisa imishini enembile ukukala imingcele ethile.
Baphinde baqopha ezinye izakhiwo zenhlabathi njengohlobo lwayo, isibonelo isihlabathi noma okufana nobumba.
Imiphumela yabo ibonise ukuthi inani lezinto eziphilayo lalihluke kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, nasekujulenini okuhlukile.
Umhlabathi ongaphezulu wawunomquba omningi kakhulu ofinyelela ku-114 milligrams (mg) ngehektare, kulandele umhlabathi ojulile (cishe u-100 mg ngehektare).
Umhlabathi ophakathi wawunenani eliphansi kakhulu elingafika ku-80 mg ngehektare.
Abacwaningi bathe izindawo ehlathini ezisanda kucishwa zazinamandla amaningi emvelo kunalezo ezingakacishwa.
Baphakamisa ukuthi ukusika izihlahla ehlathini, ngokuphathwa ngokucophelela, kungakhuphula inani lezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini.

Abacwaningi baphinde babona ukuthi umbala wenhlabathi ushintshe usuka kumnyama onsundu (inhlabathi ephezulu) uye kumnyama onsundu ophuzi (-julile), nokuthi izinhlabathi zesihlabathi nobumba zazinezinto eziphilayo eziningi.
Izindawo ehlathini ezazivezwe kakhulu elangeni zazinezihlahla ezinkulu nezindala, kanye nezinto eziningi eziphilayo.
Abacwaningi, ababezinze eZambia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathi izindlela zabo zingaguqulwa abanye ukuze bahlaziye izinga lenhlabathi ezindaweni ezahlukene nasekujulenini okuhlukile.
Ukuthuthukisa Ukukhiqizwa Nokusebenza Kwe-Chickpea Ngokusebenzisa Indlela Yabantu Ababambe Iqhaza Yezinto Ezintsha e-Ethiopia
I-chickpea (Cicer arietinum L.) iyisitshalo sesithathu esibalulekile sokudla se-legume kokubili endaweni nasekukhiqizeni ngemuva kwamabhontshisi avamile namabhontshisi e-faba eTopiya.
Kodwa-ke, ukukhiqiza kwesitshalo bekuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namandla ngenxa yokungasebenzisi izinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe nezobuchwepheshe ezikhiqizwe uhlelo locwaningo.

Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe kanye nobucwaningi obuhambisanayo, iNational Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform yasungulwa ngo-2013 ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa ababambe iqhaza abahlukene abasebenza ochungechungeni lwamanani ukuze bakhombe izinselelo ezinkulu futhi bathole izixazululo ezizosebenza ngokuhlanganyela.
Ipulatifomu ibone ukuswelakala kwembewu njengesithiyo esikhulu kulo mkhakha.
Lolu daba seluxazululiwe ngokusungula izinhlangano zabakhiqizi bembewu yabalimi ngosizo lwabalingani be-R&D futhi okwamanje bayabahlinzeki abakhulu ezweni lonke.
Ngasohlangothini, ipulatifomu yaqina umzamo wokwelula futhi yavula ukusakazwa kobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe kubalimi abaningi.
Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo ngabalimi abamamodeli kukhuphuke ngokuphindwe kane futhi ukukhiqizwa kwezwe lonke sekuphindwe kabili kwaba amathani angu-2 ha−1 eminyakeni eyishumi edlule.
Inkundla iphinde yasebenza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela emakethe futhi muva nje i-chickpea yajoyina imakethe ye-Ethiopian Commodity Exchange.
Ngokwazi amandla amakhulu okuthuthukiswa kwalesi sitshalo, ipulatifomu ilwela ukuqhubeka nokwenza ukungenelela okuqinile nokuvuna amathuba.
Indlela iTopiya eyakhulisa ngayo ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea

Abacwaningi bachaze ukuthi i-Ethiopia yandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea ngokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi banokufinyelela ezimbewini ezithuthukisiwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela zokulima ezithuthukisiwe.
Ubhontshisi we-chickpea uyisitshalo sokudla esifana nobhontshisi esivame ukutshalwa eTopiya.
Iningi lemikhiqizo yezwe liyathunyelwa kwamanye amazwe.
Eminyakeni edlule, abantu abaningi babebona ukuthi abalimi bangakhiqiza ama-chickpeas amaningi uma besebenzisa imbewu ethuthukisiwe engamelana nezinambuzane nezifo.
Incwadi yakamuva ibhala ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea e-Ethiopia kukhule kanjani kusukela ngalokho ukuqaphela.
Ababhali bathi ngo-2013, i-Ethiopia yasungula i-‘National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform’ eyaxoxa ngezinkinga ekukhiqizeni i-chickpea futhi yathola izixazululo.
Inkundla ifana nenhlangano.
Ipulatifomu ibihlanganisa abacwaningi, uMnyango Wezolimo wase-Ethiopia, izinkampani zababalimi kanye nezinyunyana, abacubunguli bokudla, abakhiqizi bezinhlamvu, kanye nabalingani bokuthekelisa.
Ababhali bathe ipulatifomu ibone ukushoda kwembewu njengenkinga enkulu, base besungula izinhlangano zokuhlinzeka ngembewu ezweni lonke.
Lolu shintsho luphindaphinde ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea kwaba amathani angu-2 ngehektha.
Enye inkinga abebeyihlonze kwakuwukuba sezingeni eliphansi kwemikhiqizo.
Baqeqesha abalimi ngezindlela ezingcono zokukhiqiza, njengokusebenzisa umquba ukuthuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi.
Baphinde baphawula ukuthi abalimi babenokuzabalaza ukulawula ukhula.
Ngakho-ke banikeze abalimi imbewu yama-chickpea engakhula kahle ngisho noma ifafazwe ngekhemikhali yokubulala ukhula, okuyizinto ezisetshenziswa abalimi ukulawula ukhula noma izitshalo ezingafuneki.
Ababhali bathi ipulatifomu iqinisekise ukuthi abalimi baqeqeshwe ukuze bandise ulwazi lwabo ekukhiqizeni utshani.
Abalimi baphinde baya emicimbini lapho bengakwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi kanye nezinto abazihlangeneyo.
Ababhali bathi leli phezulu liphinde lixhumanise abalimi nabathengi, nabakhiqizi bembewu nalabo abaphethe ukuthenga nokusabalalisa imbewu kubalimi.
Ipulatifomu iphinde yakha futhi yaqeqesha izinhlangano zabesifazane nezentsha ekukhiqizeni ama-chickpea.
Baqhubeka nokukhuthaza abesifazane nentsha ukuba babambe iqhaza ekukhiqizeni izimbewu.
Ababhali bathi naphezu kwezimfanelo ezenziwe, kusenokushoda kwembewu yama-chickpea.
Baphinde bathi le nkundla ingafeza okuningi uma bebenemithombo yokuhlangana njalo.
Bancome ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo wase-Ethiopia nabacwaningi kufanele basekele leli qonga ngemali ukuze lingawi.
Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yama-chickpea nendlela yokuphathwa kwezingozi zokukhiqizwa kwama-chickpea, njengokugula.
Ekugcineni, ababhali bacele ukuthi kube khona imbewu ethuthukisiwe eyengeziwe ezoba lula ukuvunwa kusetshenziswa imishini, futhi engathinteki ikhemikhali yokubulala ukhula.
Uhlobo lwe-SARS-CoV-2 A (A.23.1) olunokushintsha kuspaki luvele futhi luyabusa esandleni se-Uganda okwamanje.
Ukuqapha ucwaningofuzo lwe-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda kunikeza ithuba lokuhlinzeka ngencazelo egxile ekuthuthukisweni kwegciwane ezweni elincane elingaphakathi eMpumalanga Afrika.
Lapha sikhombisa ushintsho lwakamuva esifweni sendawo ngokuhlukahluka okusha okuphuma ku-A.23 okuvela ku-A.23.1 manje okuholela ezimweni zase-Uganda futhi okusabalale kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Yize izinguquko eziqondile ku-A.23.1 njengoba ilungiselelwe zihlukile kulezo eziguqukayo ezikhathazayo (VOC), ukuvela kubonisa ukuhlanganiswa kwamasethi afanayo wamaphrotheni.

Isifunda sokubhala ikhodi yephrotheni ye-spike A.23.1 siqoqe izinguquko ezifana nezinguquko eziningi ezibonwa ku-VOC okuhlanganisa ushintsho endaweni engu-613, ushintsho endaweni yokuhlukanisa i-furin elandisa isimo se-amino acid esiyisisekelo, kanye nezinguquko eziningi endaweni ye-N-terminal immunogenic.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlanga lwe-A.23.1 luhlanganisa izinguquko kumaprotheni angawona ama-spike amanye ama-VOC akhombisa (nsp6, i-ORF8 ne-ORF9).

Umthelela wezokwelapha wezinhlobo ze-A.23.1 awukacaci okwamanje, nokho kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokubhekwa ngokucophelela kwale nhlobo, kanye nokuhlola ngokushesha imiphumela yezinguquko ze-spike protein ekusebenzakaleni komgomo.
Abacwaningi babika ngoguquko lwezinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda
Ngo-2021, abacwaningi babika ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-SARS-CoV-2, okuyigciwane elibangela i-Covid-19, lwaqubuka e-Uganda lwase lusabalala kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Bayiqambe ngokuthi "A.23.1", futhi bathe inezinguquko eziningi ezifanayo kumaprotheni abacwaningi abaye bazibona kwezinye izinhlobo ezikhathazayo emhlabeni jikelele ngalesi sikhathi.
Ososayensi balandelela ukuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zokhuvethe ziguquka kanjani ukuze baqonde kangcono ukuthi imigomo ingasebenza kahle kangakanani ezinhlotsheni ezintsha.
I-Covid-19 ibulale abantu abaningi emhlabeni wonke.
Kwenqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi ukubhekwa kwe-genomic, ososayensi babheka ukuthi izakhi zofuzo namaprotheni egciwane ziguquka kanjani njengoba lisabalele.
Basebenzisa lolu lwazi ukulawula isifo nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa komgomo.
Isibonelo, ngokuqonda isakhiwo samaphrotheni egciwane, abacwaningi bangaklama imigomo eqondisa kangcono lawo maphrotheni ukusiza ukuvimbela igciwane ekungeneni kumaseli womuntu.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheka ikakhulukazi ukuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 yayiguquka kanjani e-Uganda.
Abacwaningi banquma ukulandelana kofuzo lwegciwane kumasampula e-COVID-19 aqoqwe kulo lonke elase-Uganda.

Basebenzisa isoftware yekhompyutha ukulandelela umlando womndeni (noma umlando womndeni) wezinhlobo ezintsha abazitholile ngale ndlela (ebizwa ngokuthi A.23.1), futhi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi le nguquko ifanelana kuphi emlandweni womndeni we-SARS-CoV-2.
Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lusanda kuthuthuka kolunye uhlobo olubizwa nge-A.23, futhi lwatholakala kuma-90% wazo zonke izampula ezinhle.
Ngamanye amazwi, yayisiholele phambili kumasampula ase-Uganda kusukela ngoMfumfu 2020.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lwalunezinguquko eziningana ku-phrotheni ye-spike ezifanayo nezinye izinguquko ezibonwa kwezinye izinhlobo ezikhathazayo.
Izinguquko kungenzeka zenza ukuthi uhlobo lube lula ukusabalala (lusabalale ngokushesha), futhi lube nokumelana okukhulu nemigomo kanye nokwelashwa.
Lolu cwaningo lufaka isandla emizamweni eqhubekayo yokulandelana kwezinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni jikelele.
Imiphumela ingeza ebufakazini obukhulayo bokuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 iguquka ngokushesha njengoba isakazeka ukuze ithelele abantu abaningi futhi igweme imigomo.
Nokho, kudingeka ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi yimiphi imiphumela noma imisebenzi yokuguquka kwephrotheni ye-spike kuhlobo lwe-A.23.1.
Abacwaningi batusa ukuqapha okwengeziwe kwe-genomic ukuze kusisize siqonde ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukene zegciwane ziphendula kanjani kwimigomo etholakala e-Uganda nakwamanye amazwe.
Baphinde bathi ukuqapha ukuhamba kwamazwe ngamazwe kubalulekile ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono ukuthi igciwane lisakazeka kanjani endaweni.
Yini Eyenza Owesifazane?
Izifundo Zamacala Ezibhalisa Izizathu Nezimo Zokuhlinzwa/Kusikwa Kwezitho Zobulili Kwabesifazane e-Indonesia, eTopiya naseKenya
Ukusikwa/ukuhlukunyezwa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane kuyisiko elilimazayo eliphula amalungelo abesifazane futhi linezinkinga ezimbi zezempilo.
Leli phepha libonisa izizathu nezimo zokuhlinzwa/ukusikwa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane (FGM/C) ezindaweni ezithile zamazwe amathathu - i-Indonesia, iTopiya neKenya.

Ingcobelelo yaqoqwa ngocwaningo lwasekhaya nentsha (eneminyaka engu-15-24) kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu okugxilwe kuwo, izingxoxo ezijulile kanye nenhlolokhono yezimpimpi ezibalulekile nentsha kanye nababambe iqhaza emphakathini ngowezi-2016 nowezi-2017.
Izibalo ezichazayo nokuhlaziywa kokuqukethwe kwezindikimba kwenziwa.
Imiphumela yocwaningo iqinisekisa ezinye zezizathu ze-FGM/C ezibhalwe phambilini, iphinde iqaphele ukuthi lezi zizathu zixhumene kakhulu, futhi izimiso zobulili ziyimbangela eyisisekelo.
Kuzo zonke izilungiselelo ezintathu, lezi zizathu ziqhuba izinguquko emizimbeni yabesifazane ukuze kuphumelele umzimba 'owenhlonipho' owamukelekayo esimweni sobuzwe obubuswa amadoda.
Lokhu kuholela emzimbeni 'ohlanzekile' e-Indonesia, umzimba 'othambile' e-Ethiopia kanye nomzimba 'wabantu abadala' eKenya.
Abasebenzi bezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekuthatheni izinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C kuzo zonke izimo.
E-Kenya, ikakhulukazi, izintokazi ezisencane zixoxisana ngendima yazo ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C njengoba ziba zikhulile ngesikhathi sokusoka.

Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimo zomthetho nezomphakathi eziguqukayo endaweni ngayinye ziletha izinguquko esikweni le-FGM/C okuholela ekwenzeni i-FGM/C ibe yinto yezokwelapha e-Indonesia, ukwehla kweminyaka yokusoka amantombazane eKenya kanye nokwenziwa kwe-FGM/C ngokuyimfihlo e-Ethiopia.
Lamacala amathathu akhombisa umehluko omkhulu ekwenzeni i-FGM/C kanye nencazelo yokuxhumana enikezwa yizintokazi ezisencane kanye nemiphakathi yazo.
Kunesidingo sokuqhubeka nokuhlola indima yabazali ekwenzeni izinqumo.

Ngenxa yezixhumanisi phakathi kwezinto ezahlukene ezishayela i-FGM/C ngaphakathi kwesimo ngasinye, ucwaningo luphetha ngokuthi izindlela ezithile zesimo kumele zamukelwe ukungenelela ukuze kudaleke ushintsho oluhlala isikhathi eside.
Ukuze siyeke ukusoka abesifazane, sidinga ukuqonda kuqala ukuthi kungani kwenzeka.

Ukugwazwa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane, umkhuba lapho izingxenye zezitho zangasese zabesifazane zisikwa noma zisuswa, kusenzeka ngokungemthetho noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, i-Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.
Abacwaningi bathi ukuqonda ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka kuyisihluthulelo sokumisa lo mkhuba onobungozi, nokuvimbela izinkinga zezempilo nezengqondo abesifazane abahlupheka ngenxa yazo.
Ezingxenyeni ze-Afrika ne-Asia, ukusoka izitho zangasese zabesifazane (FGM), okunye okubizwa ngokuthi ‘ukusoka kwabesifazane’, kusenziwa kakhulu.

Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngokungamanga ukuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane kuyadingeka ukuze kuhlanzwe kahle noma ukugcina abesifazane bezithobile (bengenakho ukuzikhukhumeza futhi bezithobile), futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuba nezingane.
I-FGM ayidingeki kunoma yikuphi kwalokhu ngokusho kobufakazi besayensi.
Kodwa-ke, ezimweni eziningi, izingane ezibhekene ne-FGM zigcina zinezinkinga zempilo kamuva empilweni, njengokutheleleka okuyingozi, ubunzima bokuchama, nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenxa yokuthi lo mkhuba uyingozi kakhulu futhi wephula amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi awenze waba yicala, kodwa abantu basawenza ngasese.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ukuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi abantu bakholelwa ini ngalesi senzo.
Ngakho-ke baqoqa ulwazi mayelana ne-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.

Ezweni ngalinye, abacwaningi bakhuluma nabantu mayelana nalesi senzo, kuhlanganise nabazali, intsha, abaholi bendabuko, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye 'nabahlabi' (abantu besifazane asebekhulile abake benza i-FGM ezintombini ezincane).
Kwezinye izimo, babexoxisana nalaba bantu ngabanye, kodwa baphinde bakhuluma namaqembu abantu, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala abasebasha nentsha, ababehlushwe yi-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu ze-FGM, indlela eyenziwa ngayo, nezinkolelo mayelana nalesi senzo, kwehluka emazweni ngamazwe.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi abantu abaningi basayenza, ngisho nasezindaweni lapho kungemthetho khona.

Isibonelo, e-Indonesia, abelaphi bendabuko basebenzisa ummese noma inaliti ukusika ingxenye ye-clitoris (isitho esibhekele ikakhulu injabulo yezocansi kwabesifazane) lapho ingane yentombazane inezinsuku ezingu-40 ubudala.
Abantu babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusiza 'ukususa ukungcola' futhi kwakubalulekile ngezizathu zenkolo.
E-Ethiopia, ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenzeka ngisho ngaphambili, kwesinye isikhathi lapho izingane zisanda kuzalwa zineminyaka engu-7 kuphela.
Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abantu lapho babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kwakuzoqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izoba "umfazi omuhle" ngelinye ilanga, futhi izoba nokulalela, ingabi nolaka kumyeni wayo.
Abantu abaningi nabo bakholelwa ukuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenza kube lula ukubeletha kodwa empeleni kungakwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukubeletha.
Khonamanjalo eKenya, i-FGM yayibonisa ukuthi intombazane isifinyelele ebudaleni besifazane, futhi ngokuvamile yayenzeka kamuva empilweni, lapho eseyintombazane esencane.

Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izimo bathola ukuthi amantombazane angase ahlinzwe i-FGM esemncane njengeminyaka engu-8, futhi amantombazane amaningi agcina ekhulelwe esemancane, ngoba abhekwa njengabakhulile ngokwanele ukwenza ucansi ngemva kwe-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathi okutholakele kubo kukhombisa ukuthi kunezizathu eziningi ezahlukene zokuthi i-FGM isenzeka.
Njengoba imithetho nemibono yezenhlalo ishintsha, indlela nendawo lapho kwenziwa khona kuyashintsha futhi.
Isibonelo, abazali bangase bazame ukukwenza ngasese nakuba kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuze indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.
Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi i-FGM ayivumelekile kwezinye izindawo, ukucwaninga ngalesi sihloko kungaba nzima, futhi abantu bangase bangahlali bephendula iqiniso ngalesi sihloko.

Esikhathini esizayo, ngaphezu kokwenza kube yicala, abacwaningi bathi ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele bahlosise ukumisa i-FGM ngokubhekana nezinkolelo ezingamanga abantu abanazo mayelana nalesi senzo futhi babafundise ngezingozi zalo.

Lolu cwaningo lwaluwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi base-Ethiopia, e-Indonesia nase-Netherlands, futhi luyingxenye yephrojekthi enkulu ebizwa ngokuthi uhlelo lwe-‘Yes I Do’, oluhlose ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwentsha, umshado wezingane kanye ne-FGM.

Ukungalingani KwamaHormone Okuzala, i-Germ Cell Apoptosis, i-Abnormal Sperm Morphophenotypes kanye Nezinguquko Ze-Ultrastructural ku-Testis Yamagundane Amakhulu Ase-Afrika (Cricetomys gambianus, Waterhouse, 1840) Abavezwe Ekudakweni Kwe-Sodium Metavanadate
Ukuchayeka kwemvelo ku-vanadium sekukhuphukile esikhathini esisanda kudlula.
Le nsimbi yaziwa njengonobuthi.
Ucwaningo lwamanje lwenziwa ukuze kuphenywe ubuthi bokuzala be-sodium metavanadate (SMV) kumagundane amakhulu ase-Afrika esilisa.
Ukuphathwa kwe-SMV kwenziwa ngaphakathi kwe-peritoneal nsuku zonke izinsuku eziyi-14 zilandelana ngomthamo we-3mg/kg wesisindo somzimba.
Amanzi acwengekile anikezwe iqembu lokulawula.
Sihlaziye amahomoni okuzala e-serum, isitoreji nesimo se-sperm kanye nezinguquko zesakhiwo se-testis ngemva kokwelashwa kwe-SMV.
Imiphumela yethu ibonise ukuthi iqembu le-AGR elivezwe ku-SMV libe ne-progesterone eyandisiwe ngokwezibalo kodwa kuncipha amazinga e-testosterone, FSH kanye ne-LH.

Futhi, iqembu eliphathwe nge-SMV libe nokwehla kwezibalo ekunyakazeni kwezimbumba zesidoda kanye nomsebenzi we-mass activity ngokwanda kwephesenti le-morphophenotypes engajwayelekile ye-spermatozoa kanye nokwenyuka kwesilawulo samaseli e-P53 immunopositive.
Ucwaningo lwe-ultrastructural luveze ukuvuthwa kwamaseli e-germ kanye ne-Sertoli, i-cytoplasmic kanye ne-isizinda senkombafuzo; futhi ukuvuvuka kwe-mitochondrial kanye nokuvuthwa nakho kwabhekwa.
Kube nokuhlakazeka okukhulu kwama-seminiferous tubules, i-atrophy kanye nokonakala kwamaseli e-myeloid kanye ne-apoptosis yama-Leydig, Sertoli kanye namaseli e-germ.

Ekugcineni, ukuvezwa kwe-SMV ngaphakathi kwe-peritoneal kubangela imiphumela emibi kakhulu kwamanye ama-hormone okuzala e-serum, ukuncipha kwesitoreji se-sperm kanye nekhwalithi, i-apoptosis kanye nezinguquko zokonakala kumaLeydig, Sertoli kanye namaseli ezinzalo okungaholela ekungazaleni.
Abacwaningi bathi insimbi etholakala emoyeni ongcolile yenza amagundane angabi nenzalo.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-vanadium, uhlobo lwensimbi, ilimaza amaseli amagundane kanye nekhono lawo lokuzala (ukuzala).

Ngoba le nsimbi nayo inobuthi kubantu, baphakamisa ukuthi kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuthola ukuthi le nsimbi, etholakala kakhulu endaweni yethu ngenxa yokungcola, ingaba nemiphumela emibi efanayo empilweni yabantu.
Yize i-vanadium iyinsimbi, ingangena emoyeni ngamanani amancane uma izibaso ezimbiwa phansi, njengamafutha namalahle, zishiswa.
Njengoba umhlaba usebenzisa izinsiza zokubasa eziningi, inani lokungcola kwe-vanadium liyanda.
Sesiyazi ukuthi abantu abachayeke kukho bangahlushwa izinkinga zezempilo ezifana ne-anemia, iziphongo nezamehlo ezomile, kanye nobuhlungu besifuba.
Muva nje, ososayensi baphinde bathakaseleka ngemiphumela i-vanadium engaba nayo ekuzaleni.
Sebeqalile ukufunda le miphumela kumagundane, avame ukusetshenziswa elabhorethri ngenxa yokufana kwawo nabantu.
Kulolu cwaningo, ososayensi babenentshisekelo emiphumeleni ye-vanadium ohlotsheni oluvamile lwamagundane atholakala eNtshonalanga Afrika, olubizwa ngokuthi i-African Giant Rat.
Babefuna ukuqonda ukuthi i-vanadium ishintsha kanjani izinhlelo zokuzala zamagundane esilisa, ikakhulukazi isidoda sabo, amahomoni, kanye namaseli ezindlala zabo zesidoda.
Abacwaningi bafaka i-vanadium kumagundane ayisithupha esilisa kanye ngosuku, izinsuku eziyi-14.
Ngasikhathi sinye, bafaka amanye amagundane angu-6 ngamanzi njengokuhlola "ukulawula".
Ngoba amanzi bekungeke kube nethuba lokuthinta amagundane, abacwaningi babengaqiniseka ukuthi noma yiziphi izinguquko abazibonayo kumagundane ayisithupha okuqala zaziyumphumela wokujova i-vanadium.
Ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-14, bahlola ukuthi inani lamahomoni, njenge-testosterone, lishintshile yini, futhi bahlola izitho zabo zokuzala babala isidoda sabo.

Besebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), bakwazi ukubona noma yiziphi izinguquko ezenzeke ezithweni zokuzala ngokuningiliziwe, kuze kufike ezingeni lamasosha omzimba ngamunye.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amagundane afakelwe i-vanadium ayenamazinga aphansi kakhulu e-testosterone, namanye amahomoni abalulekile ekuzaleni.
Amagundane afakelwe i-vanadium nawo abe nesidoda esincane kakhulu, futhi isidoda sawo besingaphilile kangako.
Abacwaningi babona, isibonelo, ukuthi ezinye zezimvubelo zamagundane zazingenamakhanda noma zinomsila ogobile, futhi zazingenakunyakaza njengemvubelo yamagundane afakelwe amanzi.
Ngoba isidoda yizicubu zocansi zezidalwa zesilisa, ezisetshenziselwa ukuchumisa amaqanda ezinsikeni, lezi zinguquko zingakwenza kube nzima amagundane ukuzalana ngempumelelo.
Okokugcina, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amanye amaseli avela ezindebeni zamagundane alimala kabi noma abhubhisiwe yi-vanadium.
Abacwaningi bathe izinguquko abazitholile ekugcineni zingabangela ukungabi nenzalo ngokuphelele.
Baphawule ukuthi njengoba izilwane ezivezwe ku-vanadium nakwezinye izinhlobo zokungcola emvelweni zingase zingakwazi ukuzala, zingase zibe ongasekho ngenxa yale miphumela.
Ngoba abantu bayizilwane ezincelisayo njengamagundane, ososayensi kufanele baphinde bacwaninge noma yimiphi imiphumela engemihle engase ibe khona ye-vanadium ezindaweni ezingcolile empilweni yabantu.

Abacwaningi baxwayise ngokuthi ezinye zezinguquko abazitholile ekwakhekeni kwezilwane namahomoni zazingafani nalokho okutholwe izifundo zesayensi zangaphambilini, ngakho kudingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe umonakalo obangelwa i-vanadium.

Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi abavela eNigeria naseGibhithe, futhi kungeza kulokho ososayensi abakwaziyo ngokuthi izilwane, futhi mhlawumbe nabantu, bathinteka kanjani ukungcola.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezamasiko Kwezitshalo Zasengadini Yasekhaya Emphakathini Wabomdabu ENyakatho Ntshonalanga YaseTopiya
Ukwakheka kwezitshalo ezitshalweni zasekhaya eNyakatho-ntshonalanga yeTopiya ngokujwayelekile, kanye nesifunda saseGozamin ikakhulukazi, kuthole ukunakwa okuncane kocwaningo.
Inhloso yalolu cwaningo ukuqonda kangcono ukwakheka kwezitshalo kanye nokubaluleka kwamasiko ezivandeni zasekhaya.
Inqubo yokusampula engakhethiwe ngokuhlukaniswa isetshenziswe ngokusekelwe ekwehlukaneni kwe-agroecological kumakhebele akhethiwe.

Ulwazi lwezivande zasekhaya luqoqwe ngokuhlukanisa isivande sasekhaya sibe amaquadrats amane, iquadrat yokuqala isuka endlini yomlimi iye kumamitha ayi-10, iquadrat yesibili isuka kumamitha ayi-10 iye kumamitha ayi-20, iquadrat yesithathu isuka kumamitha ayi-20 iye kumamitha ayi-30 kanti iquadrat yesine isuka kumamitha ayi-30 iye kumamitha ayi-40 ngokuvundlile kusetshenziswa indlu yomlimi njengesethenjwa kuye ngokuthi isivande sikhulu kangakanani.
Inhlolokhono engahlelekile ngokuphelele yenziwa ukuze kubhalwe ulwazi lwesaziso mayelana nezinhlobo zezitshalo.
Sekukonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibalulekile ngokwesiko ezingama-238 ezivela emindenini engu-81 ziye zahlonzwa.
Kulezi, ama-39% kwakuyizitshalo zamakhambi, ama-29% izihlahla, ama-6% kwakuyizikhuphukayo.
Izitshalo ezihlala isikhathi eside zakha ingxenye enkulu yezinhlobo ezilinywayo (83%), kanti izitshalo zonyaka zakha ingxenye esele (17%).
Umndeni we-Poaceae wawunezinhlobo eziphambili, eziyi-22, kulandele i-Fabaceae, eyayineziyi-21, kanye ne-Asteraceae eyayineziyi-15.

Kulezi zitshalo ezirekhodiwe, 140 (58.6%) kwakuyizinhlobo ezisetshenziselwa imvelo, 84 (35%) izitshalo zokudla, 83 (34.7%) izinhlobo zezinto zokwelapha, 39 (16.3%) izinhlobo zefolishi, 57 (23.8%) izitshalo zokusetshenziswa kwezinto, 60 (25%) izinhlobo zezinkuni zokubasa, 50 (21%) izitshalo zokusetshenziswa komphakathi kanye ne-1 (0.4%) enobuthi.
Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kwe-matrix kwembula ukuthi i-Cordia Africana yatholakala iyisitshalo esibalulekile ngokwesiko endaweni futhi esisengozini enkulu, kulandelwa i-Ficus sur.
Ukusetshenziswa okuphezulu kwe-Cordia africana kwakungokwakhiwa kanti inani eliphansi kwakungokwemithi.
Inkomba yokufana ka-Sorensen yamaphesenti angama-64 ezindawo ezihloliwe yayincane kuno-0.5.
Umphumela ubonise ukuthi amapulazi asekhaya ayizinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezinemisebenzi eminingi, zesikhathi eside.
Ukutholakala kokudla nokuvikelwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kusekelwa okuqhubekayo ulwazi lwamasiko abantu bendawo oluxhumene nezivande zabo zasekhaya.

Ukufana okuncane/ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo eziphakeme endaweni phakathi kwamakhebela kukhombisile ukuthi kwakukhona ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo eziphakeme lokhu kwakungenxa yezimo ezahlukene ze-agroecological phakathi kwamakhebela.
Izivande zaseTopiya zisekela ukutholakala kokudla nokuvikelwa kwemvelo.
Abacwaningi bathi abaseTopiya abaningi batshala ukudla, izitshalo zokuhlobisa, izitshalo zemithi, nezitshalo zokudla kwezilwane, umthunzi noma uthango ezivandeni zabo.
Bahlaziya lezi zingadi ukuze babone ukuthi zibaluleke kangakanani ekuqinisekiseni ukutholakala kokudla nokusiza ekuvikeleni imvelo.
Imiphakathi emhlabeni wonke igcina izingadi zokudla, ukwenza imali kanye nezinye izinhloso zamasiko.
Izindawo ezingadini nazo zivikela izitshalo ezibalulekile ezivame ukuba zingekho noma zinyamalale kwezinye izindawo.
E-Topiya, akwenziwa ucwaningo oluningi mayelana nokuthi imiphakathi itshalani ngqo ezivandeni zabo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuphenya izitshalo abantu abasesifundeni sase-Gozamin, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga ye-Ethopia, abazikhulisa emasimini abo nokuthi bazisebenzisela ini.
Bakhomba futhi babala izitshalo ezingadini ezingama-357 endaweni.
Baphinde baxoxisana nomphakathi mayelana nokuthi basebenzisa izitshalo ini.
Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi zonke izingadi eGozamin zazincane kunohektare ngobukhulu.
Baqoqe futhi bahlonza izitshalo ezihlukene ezingama-238.
Iningi (83%) lezitshalo lalitshalwe unyaka wonke, kanti ezimbalwa kuphela (17%) zazikhula ngezinkathi ezithile.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi wawusebenzisa izitshalo ukudla, imithi, ukwakha, ifolishi (ukudla kwezilwane), kanye nezinye izindlela zamasiko.
Izitshalo eziningi zisebenze izinjongo ezingaphezu kweyodwa.
Isibonelo, isihlahla esikhulu esinamagqabi amakhulu aseNyakatho singasetshenziswa emithini, ukuhlobisa, ifolishi, umthunzi, uthango kanye neminye imisebenzi yamasiko.
Ngaphezu kwengxenye (59%) yezitshalo zazisetshenziselwa izinhloso zemvelo ezifana nezicabha, izihlahla ezincane, umthunzi kanye nokuhlobisa.
Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kusize ukuvikela imvelo.
Izitshalo zothango nazo zasiza ekuvikeleni imikhiqizo yezolimo.
Kancane ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (35%) yezitshalo zazivunwa ukuze zisetshenziswe njengokudla, njengokuthi izithelo, imifino, izinhlamvu zikakolweni kanye nezithako zokunambitha.
Bathi nokho izivande endaweni zinikeza kakhulu izithelo.

Abacwaningi bathi ama-35% ezitshalo zazisetshenziswa njengemithi yesintu yokuphila kahle kwabantu nezilwane, kanti ama-21% ayesetshenziswa ezinkambisweni nasemigomweni yenkolo, ukubhema, amakha kanye nokubhaka.
Ezinye izitshalo (17%) zazisetshenziswa njengefolishi lokondla izinkomo, izimvu, nezimbongolo.
Abanye (24%) basebenza njengempahla yokwakha, ukwenza amathuluzi engadi, ukufulela uphahla nokwenza izintambo.
Njengoba iningi labantu bendawo zasemakhaya kubikwa ukuthi basebenzisa izinkuni, u-25% wezitshalo zazisetshenziswa ngalokho.
Abacwaningi bathi isitshalo esisodwa kuphela (0.4%) esashiwoyo ngenhloso yokubulala.
Baphinde bathi indlela izitshalo ezazisakazwa ngayo endaweni yayithonywa imvelo, lokho abantu abathanda ukukudla, kanye nesimo sezimali somndeni nezidingo zebhizinisi.
Isibonelo, indawo ebizwa ngokuthi i-Wenka eyayinemvula yokunisela futhi eseduze nedolobha elikhulu, yayinezivande eziningi futhi yaqopha izitshalo ezingu-130 ezihlukene.
Abantu baseWenka nabo babetshala futhi behlinzeka izithelo nemifino emakethe yedolobha.
Okokugcina, abacwaningi bathi iningi labalimi belikhetha ukutshala izitshalo ezinezindlela eziningi zokuzisebenzisa.
Abacwaningi bathe imiphumela yabo iqinisekisile ukuthi ngempela abalimi batshala izinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zezitshalo ezivandeni zabo, futhi ngezindlela ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa.
Nakuba laba bacwaningi bathole ukuthi abalimi abaningi batshala imifino, abanye abacwaningi babethi izihlahla zazivamile endaweni.
Abacwaningi balolu cwaningo bebezinze emanyuvesi eTopiya.
